samples.source: 启用流式合成之后，首段可播延迟降到 800 毫秒以内。
samples.reference: With streaming synthesis enabled, the time to first playable audio drops below 800 milliseconds.
samples.hypothesis: After enabling streaming synthesis, the time to first playable audio drops below 800 milliseconds.

samples.source: VAD 模型把这段录音切成了三个语音段，静音部分被丢弃。
samples.reference: The VAD model split this recording into three speech segments and dropped the silent parts.
samples.hypothesis: The VAD model split this recording into three speech segments, and the silence parts were discarded.

samples.source: Kokoro v1.1 用 int8 量化后模型体积约 320 MB，中文自然度接近可用。
samples.reference: After int8 quantization, Kokoro v1.1 ships at roughly 320 MB and Mandarin naturalness is close to usable.
samples.hypothesis: Kokoro v1.1 using int8 quantization has a model size of about 320 MB, with naturalness in Chinese approaching usability.

samples.source: SenseVoice 的自动语言检测在粤夹普的语料上表现不太稳定。
samples.reference: SenseVoice's automatic language detection is not very stable on Cantonese-Mandarin code-switched speech.
samples.hypothesis: The automatic language detection of SenseVoice performs inconsistently on the Cantonese-Teochew mixed language corpus.

samples.source: 实时档走 argos，端到端延迟约 200 毫秒，够做面对面场景。
samples.reference: The realtime mode runs through argos with end-to-end latency around 200 ms, fast enough for face-to-face scenarios.
samples.hypothesis: Realtime mode uses argos, with end-to-end latency around 200 milliseconds, which is suitable for face-to-face scenarios.

samples.source: 精译档走 madlad 加 ollama，质量优先，不承诺延迟预算。
samples.reference: The quality mode chains madlad and ollama and prioritizes accuracy over a latency budget.
samples.hypothesis: quality mode runs madlad plus ollama, prioritizing quality, without latency budget commitment.

samples.source: 隐私模式是硬不变量，任何配置都无法把云端引擎纳入路由。
samples.reference: Privacy mode is a hard invariant: no configuration can route cloud engines into the pipeline.
samples.hypothesis: Privacy mode is a hard invariant, and no configuration can include the cloud engine in the routing.

samples.source: 翻译记忆命中率超过三成时，成本几乎只剩模型侧的一次性开销。
samples.reference: Once the translation memory hit rate passes thirty percent, cost is essentially a one-time model expense.
samples.hypothesis: When the translation memory hit rate exceeds 30%, the cost is almost reduced to the one-time expense of the model side.

samples.source: 缓冲区太小会造成卡顿；太大会推高端到端延迟。
samples.reference: A buffer that is too small causes stuttering; one that is too large inflates end-to-end latency.
samples.hypothesis: A small buffer causes stuttering; a large buffer increases end-to-end latency.

samples.source: 音频的采样率与位深决定了原始波形的数据量。
samples.reference: The sample rate and bit depth of audio determine the volume of raw waveform data.
samples.hypothesis: The sample rate and bit depth of audio determine the data volume of the original waveform.

samples.source: 单声道 16 千赫兹 16 位是语音识别最常见的输入格式。
samples.reference: Mono 16 kHz 16-bit is the most common input format for automatic speech recognition.
samples.hypothesis: Mono 16 kHz 16-bit is the most common input format for speech recognition.

samples.source: 双声道立体声在配音场景里通常会被下混回单声道再送入 ASR。
samples.reference: Stereo dual-channel audio is usually down-mixed to mono before being fed to the ASR model in a dubbing workflow.
samples.hypothesis: Dual audio channel stereo is usually downmixed to mono for dubbing scenarios and then sent into ASR.

samples.source: 帧长 25 毫秒、帧移 10 毫秒是声学特征提取的常规配置。
samples.reference: A frame size of 25 ms and a frame shift of 10 ms is the standard setup for acoustic feature extraction.
samples.hypothesis: Frame size of 25 milliseconds and frame shift of 10 milliseconds are standard configurations for acoustic feature extraction.

samples.source: 梅尔频谱图是把波形转换成模型可读输入的关键中间表示。
samples.reference: The mel spectrogram is the key intermediate representation that turns a waveform into something the model can read.
samples.hypothesis: The mel spectrogram is a key intermediate representation that converts waveform into a model-readable input.

samples.source: 强制对齐可以把参考文本与识别输出逐字对齐，用于时间戳生成。
samples.reference: Forced alignment lines up the reference text and the recognition output word by word, used to generate timestamps.
samples.hypothesis: Forced alignment can align the reference text with the recognition output word by word, which is used for timestamp generation.

samples.source: 逆文本规整把 "二零二六年" 转成 "2026 年"，让下游解析更简单。
samples.reference: Inverse text normalization converts "two thousand twenty-six" into "2026" so downstream parsing is simpler.
samples.hypothesis: Inverse text normalization converts "二零二六年" into "2026 年", making it easier for downstream parsing.

samples.source: 中英混排句子里，专用术语最好走术语表而不是让模型自由发挥。
samples.reference: In code-switched sentences, domain terminology should be pulled from the glossary rather than left to the model's imagination.
samples.hypothesis: In code-switching sentences, specialized terminology should follow the glossary rather than let the model improvise.

samples.source: Ollama 的提示注入要显式禁用思考模式，不然首字延迟会翻倍。
samples.reference: Prompt injection into Ollama must explicitly disable thinking mode, otherwise the time to first token doubles.
samples.hypothesis: Ollama's prompt injection requires explicitly disabling the thinking mode, otherwise the time to first token will double.

samples.source: CUDA 提供程序在这块 RTX 4050 上给 TTS 带来的加速约 3 倍。
samples.reference: The CUDA provider gives TTS roughly a three-times speedup on this RTX 4050.
samples.hypothesis: The CUDA provider provides about 3 times acceleration for TTS on this RTX 4050.

samples.source: CPU 上跑 3B int8 模型的现实是每句 2 到 4 秒，不适合实时场景。
samples.reference: Running a 3B int8 model on CPU is realistically 2 to 4 seconds per sentence, not fit for realtime scenarios.
samples.hypothesis: The reality of running a 3B int8 model on CPU is 2 to 4 seconds per sentence, which is unsuitable for real-time scenarios.

samples.source: 字幕轨导出成 SRT 之后可以直接被播放器读取，不需要重新编码视频。
samples.reference: The subtitle track exported as SRT can be read directly by players without re-encoding the video.
samples.hypothesis: The subtitle track exported as SRT can be directly read by the player, without the need to re-encode the video.

samples.source: 双语字幕要求时序对齐：中文行与英文行必须落在同一时间窗口内。
samples.reference: Bilingual subtitles require timing alignment: the Chinese and English lines must share the same time window.
samples.hypothesis: Bilingual subtitles require temporal alignment: Chinese lines and English lines must fall within the same time window.

samples.source: 硬字幕是烧进画面的，之后想改只能重编码；软字幕可以随时替换。
samples.reference: Burned-in subtitles are part of the picture, so editing them later requires re-encoding; soft subtitles can be swapped at any time.
samples.hypothesis: Hard subtitles are burned into the picture, and after that, you can only re-encode to make changes; soft subtitles can be replaced anytime.

samples.source: 配音与对口型是两回事：前者关注语音替换，后者关注画面同步。
samples.reference: Dubbing and lip sync are separate concerns: the first replaces the audio, the second keeps the picture in sync.
samples.hypothesis: Dubbing and lip sync are two different things: the former focuses on speech replacement, while the latter focuses on picture synchronization.

samples.source: 声画同步误差控制在 40 毫秒以内，人眼才不会觉得违和。
samples.reference: Audio-video sync error within 40 milliseconds is imperceptible to human viewers.
samples.hypothesis: Audio-video sync error should be controlled within 40 milliseconds to prevent the human eye from feeling discomfort.

samples.source: 量化参数越高压缩率越高但画质损失越明显，需要在两者之间取舍。
samples.reference: A higher quantization parameter means a smaller bitrate but worse quality; the trade-off has to be tuned.
samples.hypothesis: Higher quantization parameters result in higher compression rates but more noticeable degradation in image quality, requiring a trade-off between the two.

samples.source: GOP 越长比特率越低但快进快退越迟钝，直播场景一般不超过 2 秒。
samples.reference: A longer GOP lowers bitrate but makes seek response sluggish; live streaming usually caps it at two seconds.
samples.hypothesis: Longer GOP results in lower bitrate but slower fast-forward and rewind. In live streaming scenarios, it is generally no more than 2 seconds.

samples.source: 词错误率与字符错误率不能相互替代，中文更常用字符错误率。
samples.reference: Word error rate and character error rate are not interchangeable; Chinese benchmarks typically report character error rate.
samples.hypothesis: Word error rate and character error rate cannot replace each other. Chinese more commonly uses character error rate.

samples.source: FLORES-101 是通用域，与产品主打的涉密文档与批量本地化场景仍有分布差。
samples.reference: FLORES-101 is general domain, still a distributional mismatch with the confidential-document and batch-localization scenarios this product targets.
samples.hypothesis: FLORES-101 is a general domain, and there is still a distribution gap compared to the confidential document and batch localization scenarios that the product focuses on.

samples.source: 术语表按语言对检索，同名条目在通用与领域之间会冲突，需要 domain 段来分组。
samples.reference: The glossary is looked up by language pair; entries with the same source term collide between generic and domain rows, so the primary key needs a domain segment.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary is searched by language pair. Same named entries may conflict between general and domain, requiring the domain segment for grouping.

samples.source: 语音活动检测的阈值调低会把呼吸声也切成语音段，调高则会吞掉句末弱读。
samples.reference: Lowering the voice activity detection threshold cuts breathing into speech segments as well; raising it swallows weak syllables at sentence ends.
samples.hypothesis: Lowering the threshold of voice activity detection will cut breath sounds into speech segments, while raising it will swallow the weakly pronounced endings of sentences.

samples.source: 自动语音识别的后处理通常包含标点恢复与数字规整两个独立步骤。
samples.reference: Post-processing for automatic speech recognition usually involves two independent steps: punctuation restoration and number normalization.
samples.hypothesis: Post-processing of automatic speech recognition typically includes two independent steps: punctuation restoration and number normalization.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译的编码器把源句压成上下文向量，解码器再自回归生成目标句。
samples.reference: In neural machine translation the encoder squeezes the source sentence into a context vector and the decoder autoregressively generates the target sentence.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder of neural machine translation compresses the source sentence into a context vector, and the decoder generates the target sentence autoregressively.

samples.source: 文本转语音的前端要做分词、字音转换和韵律预测三级流水，任一级掉链子都会破坏自然度。
samples.reference: The text-to-speech frontend runs three stages -- tokenization, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion and prosody prediction -- and a failure in any of them hurts naturalness.
samples.hypothesis: The frontend of text-to-speech synthesis needs to perform three levels of processing: word segmentation, character-to-phoneme conversion, and prosody prediction. A failure at any level will degrade the naturalness.

samples.source: 流式识别与离线识别的差别不只是延迟，还包括前缀假设与最终结果的一致性。
samples.reference: Streaming recognition differs from offline recognition not only in latency but also in the consistency between prefix hypotheses and the final result.
samples.hypothesis: The difference between streaming recognition and offline recognition is not only latency, but also the consistency between prefix assumptions and the final result.

samples.source: 同声传译产品化时最常见的取舍是 "延迟换准确率"，滑窗大小直接决定这两者。
samples.reference: The most common trade-off when productizing real-time interpretation is "buying accuracy with latency", and the sliding-window size directly determines both.
samples.hypothesis: The most common trade-off when productizing simultaneous interpretation is "latency for accuracy," and the sliding window size directly determines the two.

samples.source: 批量本地化管线要能在 1000 句的规模下保持每小时不崩，因此断点续传与幂等重跑是硬要求。
samples.reference: A batch localization pipeline must survive a thousand-sentence run for hours without crashing, which makes checkpoint-resume and idempotent retries hard requirements.
samples.hypothesis: The batch localization pipeline must remain stable at a scale of 1,000 sentences, maintaining performance per hour. Therefore, resume from breakpoint and idempotent rerun are mandatory requirements.

samples.source: 语音翻译与文本翻译共用同一套路由：TM 命中、隐私钳制、语言对分档、置信度门控、AI 升级。
samples.reference: Speech translation and text translation share the same routing: TM hit, privacy clamp, per-language-pair tiering, confidence gating and AI upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: Speech translation and text translation share the same routing: TM cache hit, privacy control, language pair tiering, confidence gating, and AI upgrade.

samples.source: 端点检测比 VAD 更严格，它需要区分 "句子说完" 与 "句中停顿"。
samples.reference: Endpoint detection is stricter than VAD -- it has to distinguish "sentence finished" from "pause inside a sentence".
samples.hypothesis: Endpoint detection is stricter than VAD, requiring the distinction between "end of a sentence" and "pauses within a sentence."

samples.source: 说话人分离在会议录音上表现好，在重叠说话的播客里就明显退化。
samples.reference: Speaker diarization works well on meeting recordings but degrades visibly on podcasts with overlapping speech.
samples.hypothesis: Speaker diarization performs well on meeting recordings but clearly degrades in overlapping speech podcasts.

samples.source: 情感语音合成需要额外一路韵律条件，不能只靠文本前端。
samples.reference: Expressive speech synthesis needs an extra prosody conditioning channel and cannot rely on the text frontend alone.
samples.hypothesis: Emotional text-to-speech requires an additional prosody condition and cannot rely solely on the text frontend.

samples.source: 零样本音色克隆只要 5 秒参考音频就能起步，但对采样率与信噪比敏感。
samples.reference: Zero-shot speaker cloning can start from just five seconds of reference audio but is sensitive to sample rate and signal-to-noise ratio.
samples.hypothesis: Zero-sample speaker timbre cloning can start with just a 5-second reference audio, but it is sensitive to sample rate and signal-to-noise ratio.

samples.source: 语音识别的置信度分数不能直接搬到翻译置信度上，两者校准曲线完全不同。
samples.reference: A speech recognition confidence score cannot be lifted directly into a translation confidence score; their calibration curves are entirely different.
samples.hypothesis: The confidence score of speech recognition cannot be directly transferred to translation confidence. Their calibration curves are completely different.

samples.source: Kokoro 的中文男声 sid 45-52 中，52 混排表现最好，48 更贴近播音腔。
samples.reference: Among Kokoro's Mandarin voices at sid 45-52, 52 handles CJK/Latin code-switching best while 48 sits closer to a broadcast tone.
samples.hypothesis: Among the Chinese male voices for Kokoro, the sid 45-52 range, sid 52 has the best mix, while sid 48 is closer to the broadcasting tone.

samples.source: Whisper 类模型在长语音上会漂移，切片策略一般按 VAD 边界而不是固定 30 秒。
samples.reference: Whisper-style models drift on long audio, so the standard slicing policy follows VAD boundaries rather than a fixed 30 seconds.
samples.hypothesis: Whisper model drifts on long speech, and the slicing strategy usually follows VAD boundaries rather than a fixed 30-second interval.

samples.source: 流式 ASR 的因果性约束意味着当前的识别不能引用未来帧，与离线模型有本质差别。
samples.reference: The causality constraint in streaming ASR means the current hypothesis cannot look ahead to future frames -- a fundamental difference from offline models.
samples.hypothesis: Causal constraints in streaming ASR mean that the current recognition cannot refer to future frames, which is fundamentally different from offline models.

samples.source: 实时字幕的常见做法是稳定前缀 + 浮动后缀，让阅读体验不至于一句话改三遍。
samples.reference: Real-time subtitles usually stabilize the prefix and let the suffix float, so a single sentence is not rewritten three times for the reader.
samples.hypothesis: The common approach for real-time subtitles is stable prefix + floating suffix, so that the reading experience does not involve changing a sentence three times.

samples.source: 批量本地化任务往往跨夜跑，日志聚合与断言式失败必须能事后重放。
samples.reference: Batch localization jobs often run overnight, so log aggregation and assertion-style failures must be replayable after the fact.
samples.hypothesis: Batch localization tasks often run overnight, and log aggregation and assertion-based failures must be replayable after the fact.

samples.source: 端到端语音翻译把 ASR、MT、TTS 融成一个模型，牺牲可解释性换更低延迟。
samples.reference: End-to-end speech translation collapses ASR, MT and TTS into a single model, trading interpretability for lower latency.
samples.hypothesis: End-to-end speech translation integrates ASR, MT, and TTS into a single model, sacrificing interpretability for lower latency.

samples.source: 语音采样率与位深决定了奈奎斯特频率上限，16 千赫兹的语音只能表达 8 千赫兹以下的成分。
samples.reference: The audio sample rate and bit depth set the Nyquist ceiling; 16 kHz speech can only carry content below 8 kHz.
samples.hypothesis: The speech sample rate and bit depth determine the upper limit of the Nyquist frequency. Speech at 16 kHz can only represent components below 8 kHz.

samples.source: 声码器负责把频谱反演回波形，Griffin-Lim 慢而糊，神经网络声码器快且清晰。
samples.reference: A vocoder inverts the spectrum back into a waveform -- Griffin-Lim is slow and muddy, while neural vocoders are fast and clean.
samples.hypothesis: The vocoder is responsible for converting the spectrum back into a waveform. Griffin-Lim is slow and blurry, while neural network vocoders are fast and clear.

samples.source: 基频 F0 的估计常用自相关或 YIN 算法，浊音段准，清音段本身就是噪声。
samples.reference: Fundamental-frequency estimation usually uses autocorrelation or YIN; both are accurate on voiced segments, but unvoiced segments are noise by definition.
samples.hypothesis: Estimating the fundamental frequency F0 is commonly done using autocorrelation or YIN algorithm. The voiced segments are accurate, while the unvoiced segments are inherently noise.

samples.source: 倒谱系数取前 40 维已经足够覆盖大部分人耳可辨的频谱特征。
samples.reference: The first 40 cepstral coefficients already cover most of the spectral detail the human ear can distinguish.
samples.hypothesis: The first 40 dimensions of cepstral coefficients are sufficient to cover most of the spectrum features that the human ear can distinguish.

samples.source: 立体声到单声道 down-mix 需要按能量归一而不是简单平均，不然左右声道的相位差会引入染色。
samples.reference: Down-mixing stereo to mono should normalize by energy rather than average samples, otherwise the phase difference between channels colors the output.
samples.hypothesis: Stereo to mono down-mix should be done by energy normalization rather than simple averaging, otherwise the phase difference between left and right audio channels will introduce coloration.

samples.source: 静音压缩通过保留 VAD 判定的语音段来实现，会议录音可以省下 30% 到 50% 时长。
samples.reference: Silence compression keeps only the segments VAD flags as speech, saving 30 to 50 percent of the length on typical meeting recordings.
samples.hypothesis: Silence compression is achieved by retaining the speech segments determined by VAD, allowing meeting recordings to save 30% to 50% of duration.

samples.source: 重采样从 48 千赫兹降到 16 千赫兹要先做抗混叠低通滤波，不然高频会折叠进语音带。
samples.reference: Resampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz must apply an anti-aliasing low-pass filter first, otherwise high frequencies fold into the speech band.
samples.hypothesis: Resampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz requires first applying an anti-aliasing low-pass filter, otherwise high frequencies will fold into the speech band.

samples.source: 信噪比低于 10 分贝的现场录音通常要先做降噪再送 ASR。
samples.reference: Field recordings with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 dB usually need denoising before being sent to ASR.
samples.hypothesis: On-site recordings with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 decibels are usually denoised before being sent to ASR.

samples.source: 预加重滤波把高频抬起来，能让后续特征提取对小擦音更敏感。
samples.reference: Pre-emphasis filtering lifts high frequencies so that later feature extraction is more sensitive to weak fricatives.
samples.hypothesis: Pre-emphasis filtering raises high frequencies, making the subsequent feature extraction more sensitive to fricatives.

samples.source: 分帧时常用的汉明窗能显著削弱矩形窗带来的吉布斯振铃。
samples.reference: A Hamming window is standard during framing and noticeably reduces the Gibbs ringing a rectangular window would introduce.
samples.hypothesis: The commonly used Hamming window in framing can significantly reduce the Gibbs ringing caused by the rectangular window.

samples.source: 帧率 25 fps 是影视的常规，50 fps 会让观众觉得 "太像新闻"。
samples.reference: A 25 fps frame rate is normal for film; 50 fps makes viewers feel it "looks too much like news footage".
samples.hypothesis: 25 fps frame rate is the standard for film, while 50 fps may make the audience feel "too news-like".

samples.source: 位深度从 16 升到 24 位不会让响度更大，但动态范围与量化噪声显著改善。
samples.reference: Raising bit depth from 16 to 24 does not increase loudness but improves dynamic range and quantization noise noticeably.
samples.hypothesis: Increasing bit depth from 16 to 24 bits does not make loudness larger, but significantly improves dynamic range and quantization noise.

samples.source: 音画同步在编码链路上要留一个音视频缓冲差，视频通常比音频晚 20 毫秒。
samples.reference: Audio-video sync has to leave a small buffer skew in the encoding chain -- video is typically about 20 ms behind audio.
samples.hypothesis: Audio-video synchronization should leave a buffer difference between audio and video on the encoding link. Video is usually 20 milliseconds behind audio.

samples.source: 声道布局从 5.1 下混到立体声要用 Dolby Pro Logic 而不是简单相加。
samples.reference: Down-mixing from 5.1 to stereo should use Dolby Pro Logic rather than a straight sum.
samples.hypothesis: Audio channel layout downmix from 5.1 to stereo should use Dolby Pro Logic instead of simple addition.

samples.source: 频谱质心、零过率、能量这三个特征就能把音乐与语音分开。
samples.reference: Spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate and energy are enough to separate music from speech.
samples.hypothesis: The features of spectrum centroid, zero crossings, and energy can separate music from speech.

samples.source: 梅尔刻度是仿人耳感知非线性；线性刻度做 FFT 直接分箱不符合听觉心理。
samples.reference: The mel scale mirrors the non-linear frequency perception of human hearing; a linear FFT binning does not match psychoacoustics.
samples.hypothesis: The Mel scale is a simulation of human ear's nonlinear perception; a linear scale directly dividing into FFT bins does not conform to psychoacoustic principles.

samples.source: 基音周期与共振峰是语音产生物理模型里最基础的两个概念。
samples.reference: Pitch period and formants are the two most basic concepts in the physical model of speech production.
samples.hypothesis: The fundamental frequency period and formant are the two most basic concepts in the physical model of speech production.

samples.source: 声纹识别与说话人分离是两回事：前者固定身份集合做识别，后者只做聚类不分身份。
samples.reference: Voiceprint recognition and speaker diarization are not the same: the first identifies a fixed set of speakers, the second only clusters without identities.
samples.hypothesis: Speaker diarization and speaker recognition are two different things: the former identifies identities from a fixed set, while the latter only performs clustering without identifying specific identities.

samples.source: 音频缓冲不足会引发 dropout，视频缓冲不足会引发跳帧，两者表现不同但根因都是背压。
samples.reference: Insufficient audio buffering causes dropouts, insufficient video buffering causes frame skips -- different symptoms but the same root cause is backpressure.
samples.hypothesis: Audio buffering insufficiency causes dropout, video buffering insufficiency causes frame skipping, they manifest differently but the root cause is backpressure.

samples.source: 流式协议里 chunk 与 packet 常被混用，但对时延统计而言是两个概念。
samples.reference: In streaming protocols chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but for latency accounting they are two different concepts.
samples.hypothesis: In streaming protocols, chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but they are two different concepts in terms of delay statistics.

samples.source: 抖动缓冲动态调整目标延迟，网络好时压到 20 毫秒，网络差时拉到 200 毫秒。
samples.reference: A jitter buffer dynamically retargets delay -- pushing it down to 20 ms when the network is good and stretching it to 200 ms when the network is bad.
samples.hypothesis: Jitter buffering dynamically adjusts the target latency, pressing it down to 20 milliseconds when the network is good and extending it to 200 milliseconds when the network is poor.

samples.source: 流水线里任何一级的吞吐瓶颈都会把上游顶爆，反压信号必须能一路传回输入端。
samples.reference: Any throughput bottleneck in a pipeline will back up everything upstream, so the backpressure signal has to propagate all the way to the input.
samples.hypothesis: Any throughput bottleneck in any stage of the pipeline will burst the upstream, and the backpressure signal must be able to propagate all the way back to the input end.

samples.source: TCP 的重传会破坏实时性，音视频低延迟场景普遍走 UDP 加前向纠错。
samples.reference: TCP retransmission ruins real-time behaviour; low-latency audio and video usually ride on UDP with forward error correction.
samples.hypothesis: TCP's retransmission can damage real-time performance, and low-latency audio and video scenarios generally use UDP with forward error correction.

samples.source: 关键帧间隔太长会让 seek 卡顿，太短会让相同画质下比特率翻倍。
samples.reference: Keyframes spaced too far apart make seeking stutter; too close and the bitrate doubles for the same quality.
samples.hypothesis: A long keyframe interval can cause seek lag, while a short interval can double the bitrate for the same video quality.

samples.source: 分块处理时相邻块要有 50% 重叠，不然边界处的能量估计会跳变。
samples.reference: Chunked processing needs 50 percent overlap between adjacent chunks, otherwise the energy estimate jumps at the boundaries.
samples.hypothesis: Chunking requires that adjacent chunks have 50% overlap, otherwise the energy estimation at the boundaries will experience abrupt changes.

samples.source: 冲刷操作的语义是 "把当前缓冲里的内容全部吐出去并结束本段"。
samples.reference: Flush means "emit everything currently in the buffer and terminate this segment".
samples.hypothesis: The semantic of flush operation is "to empty all the content in the current buffer and end the current segment".

samples.source: 端到端流水线里背压没设计好时，最下游的消费者慢就整条链堵死。
samples.reference: If backpressure is not designed in an end-to-end pipeline, a slow consumer at the tail stalls the entire chain.
samples.hypothesis: When backpressure is not properly designed in an end-to-end pipeline, the slowest downstream consumer can cause the entire chain to block.

samples.source: 缓冲预取一般按帧数而不是按时长，因为帧才是模型的原子单位。
samples.reference: Buffer prefetch usually counts in frames, not in seconds, because a frame is the atomic unit of the model.
samples.hypothesis: Buffering prefetch is usually based on the number of frames rather than duration, because frames are the atomic units of the model.

samples.source: 流式合成的边界要落在词或短语之后，切在助词或连词中间会明显刺耳。
samples.reference: Streaming synthesis boundaries should land after a word or phrase; cutting at a particle or conjunction is audibly jarring.
samples.hypothesis: The boundary of streaming synthesis should fall after words or phrases, and cutting in the middle of particles or conjunctions will sound noticeably harsh.

samples.source: 数据报传输协议丢一两个包时解码器要能优雅丢帧而不是崩。
samples.reference: When the datagram transport protocol drops one or two packets, the decoder should gracefully conceal rather than crash.
samples.hypothesis: When data packets are lost during datagram transmission, the decoder should be able to gracefully drop frames rather than crash.

samples.source: 恒定比特率适合广播，可变比特率适合存储；两者的缓冲模型完全不同。
samples.reference: Constant bitrate suits broadcast, variable bitrate suits storage -- their buffering models are completely different.
samples.hypothesis: Constant bitrate is suitable for broadcasting, and variable bitrate is suitable for storage; their buffering models are completely different.

samples.source: 容器只负责封装与同步，编解码器负责压缩；把 mkv 转成 mp4 不需要重编码。
samples.reference: The container only handles packaging and synchronisation; the codec handles compression. Turning an mkv into an mp4 needs no re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: The container is responsible for packaging and synchronization, while the codec handles compression; converting MKV to MP4 does not require re-encoding.

samples.source: 比特流的网络抽象层携带时序与合成信息，缺失会让解码器无法正确解码。
samples.reference: The network abstraction layer of the bitstream carries timing and composition information; missing it leaves the decoder unable to render correctly.
samples.hypothesis: The network abstraction layer of the bit stream carries timing and synthesis information; its absence will prevent the decoder from decoding correctly.

samples.source: 编码器要显式声明 profile 与 level，播放器据此判断能不能吃下这条流。
samples.reference: The encoder must declare its profile and level explicitly so the player can decide whether it can accept this stream.
samples.hypothesis: The encoder must explicitly declare the profile and level, so that the player can determine whether it can handle this stream.

samples.source: 解复用就是把一个容器拆开成若干条音视频字幕轨，不做任何解码。
samples.reference: Demultiplexing means splitting a container into its video, audio and subtitle tracks without decoding anything.
samples.hypothesis: Demultiplexing is to split a container into several audio, video, and subtitle tracks without any decoding.

samples.source: 无损压缩对波形做熵编码，可以逐比特还原；有损压缩引入量化误差。
samples.reference: Lossless compression entropy-codes the waveform and can restore it bit-for-bit; lossy compression introduces quantization error.
samples.hypothesis: Lossless compression applies entropy coding to waveform, allowing bit-by-bit reconstruction; lossy compression introduces quantization error.

samples.source: 转码时如果源和目标编解码器不同，一定要经过帧缓冲重排。
samples.reference: Transcoding between different source and target codecs must go through a frame buffer for reorder.
samples.hypothesis: When transcoding, if the source and target codecs are different, frame buffering and rearrangement must be performed.

samples.source: 帧内预测只依赖当前帧，帧间预测要引用参考帧，二者的错误传播特性不同。
samples.reference: Intra-frame prediction depends only on the current frame; inter-frame prediction references other frames, and the two propagate errors differently.
samples.hypothesis: Intra-frame prediction depends only on the current frame, while inter-frame prediction refers to reference frames, and they have different error propagation characteristics.

samples.source: 运动估计的搜索半径越大越精确但也越慢，默认 16 像素是常见折中。
samples.reference: A larger motion-estimation search radius is more accurate but slower; 16 pixels is the common default.
samples.hypothesis: A larger search radius in motion estimation leads to higher accuracy but slower performance. A default of 16 pixels is a common compromise.

samples.source: 熵编码用霍夫曼或算术编码；算术编码效率略高但专利与复杂度都是负担。
samples.reference: Entropy coding uses Huffman or arithmetic coding -- the latter is slightly more efficient but carries patent and complexity overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Entropy coding uses Huffman or arithmetic coding; arithmetic coding is slightly more efficient but patents and complexity are drawbacks.

samples.source: 码率控制要感知内容，静态场景压低码率，运动场景放开码率。
samples.reference: Rate control should be content-aware: lower bitrate for static scenes, higher bitrate for motion-heavy scenes.
samples.hypothesis: Rate control should perceive content, lower the rate for static scenes, and increase the rate for moving scenes.

samples.source: AVC、HEVC、VVC 每一代同画质下比特率大致降一半，复杂度大约翻倍。
samples.reference: Each generation from AVC to HEVC to VVC roughly halves the bitrate for the same quality but doubles the complexity.
samples.hypothesis: AVC, HEVC, VVC each generation reduces bitrate by about half for the same picture quality, while complexity roughly doubles.

samples.source: Opus 在 6 到 512 千比特率之间自适应，是互联网语音的默认选择。
samples.reference: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbps and is the default choice for voice on the internet.
samples.hypothesis: Opus adapts between 6 to 512 kilobitrate and is the default choice for internet speech.

samples.source: FLAC 无损压缩率大约 5:1，适合母带归档；MP3 是有损，别用来做二压。
samples.reference: FLAC compresses losslessly around 5:1 and is suited to archiving masters; MP3 is lossy and should never be secondarily compressed.
samples.hypothesis: FLAC lossless compression ratio is about 5:1, suitable for master archive; MP3 is lossy, do not use it for re-encoding.

samples.source: 视频字幕要处理换行宽度、字符编码与字体缺字三个独立问题。
samples.reference: Video subtitles have to handle three independent problems: line-width wrapping, character encoding and missing glyphs.
samples.hypothesis: Video subtitles need to handle three independent issues: line width, character encoding, and font missing characters.

samples.source: SubRip 只有时间轴与文本两栏，样式能力弱；ASS 有事件与样式两栏，能表达卡拉OK。
samples.reference: SubRip only has timing and text fields, weak styling; ASS adds event and style sections and can express karaoke effects.
samples.hypothesis: SubRip has only two columns for timeline and text, with weak styling capabilities; ASS has two columns for events and styles, and can express karaoke.

samples.source: WebVTT 是 W3C 定义的网页字幕格式，天然与 HTML5 播放器对接。
samples.reference: WebVTT is the W3C-defined subtitle format for the web and slots straight into HTML5 players.
samples.hypothesis: WebVTT is a web subtitle format defined by W3C, which naturally integrates with HTML5 playback.

samples.source: 逐字时间戳需要强制对齐输出，纯 ASR 只有段级时间戳。
samples.reference: Word-level timestamps require forced-alignment output; ASR alone only provides segment-level timing.
samples.hypothesis: Word-level timestamps require forced alignment output, while pure ASR only has segment-level timestamps.

samples.source: 字幕断行要按语义而不是按字符数：把 "声画同步" 拆到两行会破坏阅读。
samples.reference: Subtitle line breaks should follow meaning rather than character count; splitting "audio-video sync" across two lines wrecks readability.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitles should wrap by meaning rather than by character count: splitting "audio-video sync" into two lines will disrupt readability.

samples.source: 硬字幕化流程 = 抽帧、烧字、重编码；每一步都可能引入代际损失。
samples.reference: Burning in subtitles means extracting frames, drawing captions and re-encoding -- each step can add a generation of loss.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle hardcoding process = frame extraction, subtitle burning, and re-encoding; each step may introduce generation loss.

samples.source: 对口型算法在真人上主要看嘴部关键点，在动画上要看帧与语音能量包络。
samples.reference: Lip-sync algorithms track mouth keypoints on real people and match frame-by-frame energy envelopes on animation.
samples.hypothesis: Lip sync algorithm mainly focuses on mouth key points on real humans, and on frame and speech energy envelope on animations.

samples.source: 配音时原声要压低 12 分贝做 ducking，不然观众听不清配音。
samples.reference: When dubbing, duck the original audio by 12 dB or viewers will miss the new voice.
samples.hypothesis: During dubbing, the original sound should be lowered by 12 decibels to do ducking, otherwise the audience will not hear the dubbing clearly.

samples.source: 解说场景往往需要保留少量背景音，纯静音配音会让人出戏。
samples.reference: Voiceover scenes usually keep a little background ambience; pure silence makes the viewer drop out of the scene.
samples.hypothesis: Explanatory scenes often require retaining some background sounds; pure silence dubbing can make the audience feel disconnected.

samples.source: 多角色配音要按说话人分离结果分别合成，再按时间戳混流。
samples.reference: Multi-role dubbing must synthesise each speaker separately by diarization result, then remux by timestamp.
samples.hypothesis: Multi-speaker dubbing should be synthesized separately based on speaker diarization results, then mixed by timestamp.

samples.source: 双语字幕对齐时如果两边段落数不同，宁可拆段也不要错开。
samples.reference: When bilingual subtitles have mismatched segment counts, split segments rather than let them drift out of phase.
samples.hypothesis: When aligning bilingual subtitles and the number of paragraphs on both sides differ, it is better to split paragraphs than to misalign them.

samples.source: 时间轴漂移在长视频里会累积，每 10 分钟要人工核对一次锚点。
samples.reference: Timeline drift accumulates on long videos; check the anchors by hand every ten minutes.
samples.hypothesis: Timeline drift accumulates in long videos, and the anchor points need to be manually checked every 10 minutes.

samples.source: 音轨抽取常用 ffmpeg 的 -vn 参数，代价是重封装而不是重编码。
samples.reference: Extracting an audio track usually uses ffmpeg's -vn flag; the cost is remuxing, not re-encoding.
samples.hypothesis: Audio track extraction commonly uses the -vn parameter of ffmpeg, at the cost of rewrapping instead of reencoding.

samples.source: 字幕嵌入视频流会让不支持字幕的播放器也能显示，代价是不可关闭。
samples.reference: Embedding subtitles into the video stream lets even non-subtitle players display them, at the cost of losing the on/off toggle.
samples.hypothesis: Embedding subtitles into a video stream allows players that do not support subtitles to display them, at the cost of being unable to disable them.

samples.source: 视频重封装时如果编码格式没变，可以逐包拷贝，秒级完成。
samples.reference: Remuxing a video where the codec has not changed can copy packet-by-packet and finish in seconds.
samples.hypothesis: When video remuxing and the encoding format remains the same, you can copy packet by packet for a near-instantaneous completion.

samples.source: 帧精确的字幕对齐要求毫秒级时间戳，段级精度在快语速时不够用。
samples.reference: Frame-accurate subtitle alignment requires millisecond timestamps; segment-level accuracy is not enough for fast speech.
samples.hypothesis: Frame-accurate subtitle alignment requires millisecond-level timestamps, while segment-level precision is insufficient at fast speaking rates.

samples.source: 时间码 SMPTE 12 小时制在 30 帧率下有掉帧与非掉帧两种，跨系统同步时要显式声明。
samples.reference: SMPTE 12-hour timecode has drop-frame and non-drop-frame variants at 30 fps; state which one when synchronising across systems.
samples.hypothesis: Timecode SMPTE 12-hour format has both dropped and non-dropped frames at 30 frame rate, and needs to be explicitly declared when synchronizing across systems.

samples.source: 配音脚本的时长要与原视频对齐，写译文时要按 "口型开放度" 估算音节上限。
samples.reference: Dubbing scripts must match the duration of the original video; when writing translations, estimate the syllable budget from visible mouth openness.
samples.hypothesis: The duration of the dubbing script should align with the original video. When writing the translation, estimate the syllable limit based on "mouth opening degree."

samples.source: 模型检查点最好同时保存权重、优化器状态与 tokenizer，方便续训与推理。
samples.reference: A model checkpoint should store weights, optimiser state and the tokenizer together, so resuming training and inference are both easy.
samples.hypothesis: Model checkpoints should save weights, optimizer state, and tokenizer together to facilitate continued training and inference.

samples.source: 子词切分把未登录词拆成可组合的部件，词表大小与切分粒度直接相关。
samples.reference: Subword tokenization breaks unknown words into combinable pieces; vocabulary size and merge granularity are directly related.
samples.hypothesis: Subword segmentation splits unknown words into combinable components, and the size of the vocabulary is directly related to the granularity of segmentation.

samples.source: 字节对编码从字符级开始反复合并高频对，构造出面向该语料的最优词表。
samples.reference: Byte-pair encoding starts from characters and repeatedly merges the most frequent pairs, producing a vocabulary optimised for that corpus.
samples.hypothesis: Byte-pair encoding starts from the character level and repeatedly merges high-frequency pairs to construct an optimal vocabulary for the given corpus.

samples.source: 词嵌入把符号映射到连续空间，语义相近的词在向量空间里距离更近。
samples.reference: Word embeddings map symbols into continuous space so that semantically similar words lie close together in the vector space.
samples.hypothesis: Word embedding maps symbols into a continuous space, with semantically similar words being closer in the vector space.

samples.source: 注意力机制允许解码器在每一步软选择性地查看源句的所有位置。
samples.reference: Attention allows the decoder at every step to softly inspect every position in the source sentence.
samples.hypothesis: The attention mechanism allows the decoder to softly selectively view all positions of the source sentence at each step.

samples.source: Transformer 用自注意力替代循环结构，训练时并行度高但推理时 KV 缓存吃内存。
samples.reference: The Transformer replaces recurrence with self-attention -- high parallelism during training, but KV-cache cost at inference time.
samples.hypothesis: Transformer replaces recurrent structures with self-attention, achieving high parallelism during training but consuming memory with KV cache during inference.

samples.source: 量化到 int8 后模型体积大约压到三分之一，速度提升视硬件与算子而定。
samples.reference: Quantising to int8 shrinks the model to about a third of its size; the speed gain depends on hardware and operators.
samples.hypothesis: After quantization to int8, the model size is reduced to about one third. The speed improvement depends on the hardware and operators.

samples.source: 半精度 fp16 保留浮点动态范围，训练时用得多；int8 推理时用得多。
samples.reference: Half-precision fp16 keeps the dynamic range of floats and is used heavily in training; int8 is used heavily in inference.
samples.hypothesis: Half precision fp16 retains the dynamic range of floating points and is widely used during training; int8 is more commonly used during inference.

samples.source: 知识蒸馏把大模型的软标签灌给小模型，让后者逼近前者的准确率。
samples.reference: Knowledge distillation feeds the soft labels of a large model into a small model so the latter approaches the former's accuracy.
samples.hypothesis: Knowledge distillation transfers the soft labels from a large model to a small model, allowing the latter to approach the accuracy of the former.

samples.source: 教师模型可以是 30B 参数，学生模型压到 1B，蒸馏后小模型在窄任务上不掉太多。
samples.reference: The teacher might have 30B parameters and the student only 1B; a distilled student loses surprisingly little on a narrow task.
samples.hypothesis: The teacher model can be 30B parameters, and the student model can be compressed to 1B. After distillation, the small model does not lose much performance on narrow tasks.

samples.source: 微调在特定领域语料上继续训练，学习率要显著低于预训练阶段。
samples.reference: Fine-tuning continues training on a domain-specific corpus at a much lower learning rate than pretraining.
samples.hypothesis: Fine-tuning continues training on specific domain corpora with a learning rate significantly lower than the pre-training phase.

samples.source: LoRA 只训练两个低秩矩阵，参数量与原模型相比不到百分之一。
samples.reference: LoRA only trains two low-rank matrices, less than one percent of the base model's parameter count.
samples.hypothesis: LoRA trains only two low-rank matrices, with parameter count less than one percent compared to the original model.

samples.source: 推理时 batch size 越大吞吐越高但延迟也越长，实时场景往往锁死 batch=1。
samples.reference: At inference time, larger batch size raises throughput but also latency; realtime pipelines usually lock batch=1.
samples.hypothesis: During inference, larger batch size leads to higher throughput but longer latency. In real-time scenarios, the batch size is often fixed at 1.

samples.source: 线程数不是越多越好；ONNX 的 inter-op 与 intra-op 要分开调。
samples.reference: More threads are not always better; ONNX's inter-op and intra-op thread counts have to be tuned separately.
samples.hypothesis: Thread count is not better the more; ONNX's inter-op and intra-op should be called separately.

samples.source: 算子融合把多个小算子合并成一个大算子，减少内存往返与调度开销。
samples.reference: Operator fusion collapses several small operators into one, reducing memory round-trips and scheduling overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Operator fusion combines multiple small operators into a single large operator, reducing memory round trips and scheduling overhead.

samples.source: 计算图优化是推理框架的核心工作，图切分决定哪些算子留在 CPU 哪些上 GPU。
samples.reference: Computation-graph optimisation is the core work of an inference framework; graph partitioning decides which operators stay on CPU and which move to GPU.
samples.hypothesis: Graph optimization is the core work of the inference framework, and graph partitioning determines which operators stay on CPU and which go to GPU.

samples.source: 运行时提供程序的选择影响极大，同一模型在 CUDA 与 CPU 上可能差 5 到 10 倍。
samples.reference: Choosing the runtime provider matters a lot -- the same model can be 5 to 10 times faster on CUDA than on CPU.
samples.hypothesis: The choice of runtime provider has a significant impact. The same model may differ by 5 to 10 times between CUDA and CPU.

samples.source: 显存不足时 Ollama 会自动把部分层卸载到内存，速度骤降但不会崩。
samples.reference: When VRAM is insufficient Ollama offloads some layers to main memory; throughput collapses but the process survives.
samples.hypothesis: When VRAM is insufficient, Ollama automatically offloads some layers to memory, resulting in a significant drop in speed but no crash.

samples.source: 批大小与序列长度的乘积决定 KV 缓存的显存开销。
samples.reference: The product of batch size and sequence length determines the VRAM cost of the KV cache.
samples.hypothesis: The product of batch size and sequence length determines the VRAM cost of KV cache.

samples.source: 多语言模型用一份参数覆盖 100 多种语言，冷门语向的质量通常明显低于热门语向。
samples.reference: A multilingual model covers more than a hundred languages with one set of weights, and quality on cold pairs is usually much lower than on hot pairs.
samples.hypothesis: Multilingual models cover over 100 languages with a single set of parameters, and the quality of less common language directions is usually significantly lower than that of popular language directions.

samples.source: 分词器与模型的词表必须严格匹配，错配会导致输出乱码但不报错。
samples.reference: The tokenizer and the model's vocabulary must match exactly; a mismatch produces garbled output without raising an error.
samples.hypothesis: The tokenizer and the model's vocabulary must strictly match. Mismatched results will cause output garbled text but no error.

samples.source: 温度采样把概率分布拉平，让模型输出更多样，但翻译场景通常希望更低温度。
samples.reference: Temperature sampling flattens the probability distribution and yields more varied output, but translation typically wants lower temperature.
samples.hypothesis: Temperature sampling flattens the probability distribution, leading to more diverse model outputs, but translation scenarios typically prefer lower temperatures.

samples.source: 上下文窗口是 LLM 的硬约束，长文档翻译要么截断要么分段喂。
samples.reference: The context window is a hard constraint on the LLM; long documents must be truncated or fed one sentence at a time.
samples.hypothesis: The context window is a hard constraint for LLMs. Long document translation either truncates or segments the input.

samples.source: 系统提示里显式列出术语表可以显著降低专业词错译，但会占用输入 token。
samples.reference: Listing the glossary explicitly inside the system prompt significantly reduces terminology errors but consumes input tokens.
samples.hypothesis: Listing the glossary explicitly in the system prompt can significantly reduce the risk of mistranslating professional terms, but it will consume input tokens.

samples.source: 少样本示例把 "用户希望的译法" 直接摆到模型眼前，比抽象指令更有效。
samples.reference: Few-shot examples put the user's preferred rendering directly in front of the model, which beats any abstract instruction.
samples.hypothesis: Few-shot examples present the "desired translation" directly before the model, which is more effective than abstract instructions.

samples.source: 术语表要按当前请求的语言对与领域过滤，把不相关条目喂给模型只会稀释注意力。
samples.reference: Glossaries must be filtered by the current request's language pair and domain; feeding irrelevant rows only dilutes attention.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary should be filtered based on the current request's language pair and domain. Feeding irrelevant entries to the model will dilute its focus.

samples.source: 翻译记忆是精确匹配，命中即零成本；模糊匹配是另一码事，会引入排序噪声。
samples.reference: Translation memory matches exactly -- a hit is zero-cost; fuzzy matching is a different problem and brings ranking noise.
samples.hypothesis: Translation memory is exact match, cache hit means zero cost; fuzzy match is another matter, which introduces sorting noise.

samples.source: 置信度门控是本地结果与 AI 升级之间的开关，阈值定太松会白白多花一次 API。
samples.reference: Confidence gating is the switch between local output and AI upgrade; too permissive a threshold wastes API calls.
samples.hypothesis: Confidence gating is a switch between local results and AI upgrade, setting the threshold too loosely will result in unnecessary API calls.

samples.source: 质量分记录每条 TM 的历史可信度，AI 写入通常是 0.95，本地是估算，手动是 1.0。
samples.reference: The quality score records each TM entry's historical reliability -- AI writes at 0.95, local estimates its own, manual writes 1.0.
samples.hypothesis: The quality score records the historical credibility of each TM. AI writing is usually 0.95, local is estimated, and manual is 1.0.

samples.source: 兜底降级必须携带原因说明，让调用方知道 "翻不出" 和 "翻错了但降级返回" 是两回事。
samples.reference: Fallback degradation must carry a reason so the caller can tell "could not translate" apart from "translated wrong but degraded anyway".
samples.hypothesis: Fallback degradation must carry a reason explanation, so that the caller knows that "being unable to flip" and "flipping incorrectly but degrading the return" are two different things.

samples.source: 不静默降级是本产品的硬约束：任何路径回落都要写进 message 字段。
samples.reference: No silent degradation is this product's hard constraint: every fallback must be written into the message field.
samples.hypothesis: No silent degradation is a hard constraint of this product: any path rollback must be written into the message field.

samples.source: 蒸馏从 AI 精译结果中抽术语回灌本地引擎，形成 "越用越省" 的性价比飞轮。
samples.reference: Distillation extracts terms from AI quality translations and feeds them back into local engines, forming a "cheaper the more you use it" flywheel.
samples.hypothesis: Distillation feeds distilled terminology back into the local engine from AI fine-tuned results, creating a cost-effectiveness flywheel of "the more you use, the more you save."

samples.source: 命中率与质量分是彼此冲突的：低质量记忆对反复命中会污染输出。
samples.reference: Hit rate and quality score fight each other -- repeatedly hitting a low-quality memory pair poisons the output.
samples.hypothesis: Hit rate and quality score are conflicting with each other: low-quality memories pollute the output through repeated hits.

samples.source: LRU 缓存要预留一定命中率作为预热指标，冷启动阶段不能过早淘汰。
samples.reference: The LRU cache should reserve a hit-rate threshold as the warm-up signal; the cold-start phase must not evict too aggressively.
samples.hypothesis: LRU cache should reserve a certain hit rate as a warmup metric, and during the cold start phase, items should not be evicted too early.

samples.source: 端到端评估的样本要覆盖三种场景：完全命中、缓存质量不足重译、无缓存纯翻译。
samples.reference: End-to-end evaluation samples must cover three scenarios: perfect hit, cache-quality-refused re-translation, and cold translation without cache.
samples.hypothesis: The samples for end-to-end evaluation should cover three scenarios: cache hit, insufficient cache quality retranslation, and no-cache pure translation.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译对训练域极其敏感；把 Wiki 语料训出来的模型直接搬到会议记录，质量掉得很明显。
samples.reference: Neural machine translation is extremely sensitive to the training domain -- a model trained on Wikipedia drops heavily when used on meeting transcripts.
samples.hypothesis: Neural machine translation is extremely sensitive to the training domain; the model trained with Wiki corpus performs significantly worse when directly applied to meeting records.

samples.source: 大语言模型在冷启动阶段能靠世界知识翻译专有名词，但没有术语注入时同名词在长文档里译法会漂。
samples.reference: A large language model can translate proper nouns in a cold start using world knowledge, but without term injection the same term can drift across a long document.
samples.hypothesis: Large language models can translate proper nouns using world knowledge during the cold start phase, but without term injection, the translation of the same term in long documents may vary.

samples.source: 统计机器翻译依赖短语表与对齐语料，工程上比神经翻译更难维护但延迟可控。
samples.reference: Statistical machine translation relies on phrase tables and aligned corpora; harder to maintain in production but latency is predictable.
samples.hypothesis: Statistical machine translation relies on phrase tables and aligned corpora, which are more difficult to maintain than neural translation in engineering but have controllable latency.

samples.source: 实时因子 RTF 是模型耗时代价除以音频时长，小于 1 才可能做实时。
samples.reference: The real-time factor RTF is the model's compute cost divided by the audio length; only RTF below 1 makes realtime feasible.
samples.hypothesis: Real-time factor RTF is the model computation cost divided by audio duration, and it must be less than 1 to achieve real-time performance.

samples.source: 首字延迟决定用户对 "快不快" 的第一印象；总时长决定 "等得起等不起"。
samples.reference: Time-to-first-token decides the user's gut feeling of "fast"; total time decides whether they can "wait".
samples.hypothesis: Time to first token determines the user's first impression of "how fast"; total duration determines "whether to wait or not".

samples.source: 挂钟时间是端到端测出来的，包含排队与网络往返，与 CPU 时间不是一回事。
samples.reference: Wall-clock time is measured end-to-end and includes queuing and network round-trips; it is not the same as CPU time.
samples.hypothesis: Wall-clock time is measured end-to-end, including queuing and network round trip, and is not the same as CPU time.

samples.source: 冷启动阶段第一次推理会加载权重、构建计算图，比稳态慢一个数量级。
samples.reference: The first inference during a cold start loads weights and builds the computation graph, taking an order of magnitude longer than steady state.
samples.hypothesis: The first inference during cold start loads weights and builds the computation graph, which is one order of magnitude slower than the steady state.

samples.source: 预热一般用几条虚拟请求把权重从磁盘拉到内存并触发惰性优化。
samples.reference: Warmup usually fires a few synthetic requests to bring weights from disk into memory and to trigger lazy graph optimisation.
samples.hypothesis: Warmup usually uses several virtual requests to pull the weight from disk to memory and trigger lazy optimization.

samples.source: 内存占用对桌面产品是硬约束，用户能接受 CPU 慢但不能接受 OOM。
samples.reference: Memory footprint is a hard constraint for desktop products -- users will accept CPU slowness but not OOM.
samples.hypothesis: Memory footprint is a hard constraint for desktop products. Users can tolerate slow CPU but cannot accept OOM.

samples.source: 每秒查询数是服务端指标，对单机桌面产品意义不大。
samples.reference: Queries per second is a server metric and says little about a single-machine desktop product.
samples.hypothesis: Queries per second is a server-side metric and has little significance for single-machine desktop products.

samples.source: 性能剖析要区分推理耗时、编解码耗时与 IO 耗时，不然优化容易打偏。
samples.reference: Profiling must separate inference time, codec time and I/O time, otherwise optimisation ends up targeting the wrong thing.
samples.hypothesis: Profiling should distinguish between inference time, encoding/decoding time, and IO time, otherwise optimization efforts may be misdirected.

samples.source: 端到端吞吐受限于最慢的一段，优化前先找出瓶颈段。
samples.reference: End-to-end throughput is capped by the slowest stage; find the bottleneck before optimising.
samples.hypothesis: End-to-end throughput is limited by the slowest segment. Before optimization, identify the bottleneck segment.

samples.source: 基准测试要固定 seed、固定采样策略，两次跑同一模型输出应可复现。
samples.reference: Benchmarks must pin the seed and the sampling policy, otherwise two runs on the same model are not comparable.
samples.hypothesis: Benchmarking should fix the seed and sampling strategy, ensuring that the same model produces reproducible outputs in two runs.

samples.source: 延迟测试期间不能有并发下载或杀毒扫描，否则会污染数字。
samples.reference: Latency measurements are ruined by concurrent downloads or antivirus scans; run them on an idle machine.
samples.hypothesis: No concurrent downloads or antivirus scans are allowed during latency testing, otherwise it will contaminate the data.

samples.source: 缓冲区在 AV 域是 audio buffer；在化学语境下是 buffer solution。
samples.reference: In AV context a buffer is an audio buffer; in chemistry it is a buffer solution.
samples.hypothesis: The buffer is audio buffer in AV domain; it is buffer solution in chemical context.

samples.source: stream 在流式合成里是 "流"；在统计语境是 "数据流"，在地理语境是 "溪流"。
samples.reference: A stream in streaming synthesis is a data stream; in statistics it is a data stream too, but in geography it is a brook.
samples.hypothesis: stream in streaming synthesis refers to "stream"; in statistical context, it refers to "data stream", and in geographical context, it refers to "stream".

samples.source: channel 在音频里是 "声道"；在消息队列里是 "通道"；在营销里是 "渠道"。
samples.reference: A channel in audio is a channel; in a message queue it is a channel; in marketing it is also a channel -- different meanings.
samples.hypothesis: Channel refers to "audio channel" in audio context; "channel" in message queue context; and "channel" in marketing context.

samples.source: segment 在 VAD 里是 "语音段"；在商业语境是 "市场份额"；在几何是 "线段"。
samples.reference: A segment in VAD is a speech segment; in business it is a market segment; in geometry it is a line segment.
samples.hypothesis: segment in VAD is "speech segment"; in business context is "market share"; in geometry is "line segment".

samples.source: voice 在 TTS 里更常见的是 "音色 / 说话人声线"，不是物理意义的 "声音"。
samples.reference: In TTS, voice most often means the speaker's timbre, not the physical sense of sound.
samples.hypothesis: In TTS, "voice" is more commonly referred to as "speaker timbre" rather than the physical meaning of "sound".

samples.source: speech 强调 "口语演讲" 与 "语音信号"；voice 更偏 "嗓音" 与 "说话主体"。
samples.reference: Speech emphasises spoken language and the acoustic signal; voice leans toward the voice quality and the speaking subject.
samples.hypothesis: Speech emphasizes "oral presentation" and "speech signal"; voice is more偏向 "voice" and "speaker".

samples.source: frame 在编码域是 "帧"，在窗口/画框域也是 "frame"，靠上下文区分。
samples.reference: Frame means frame in the codec context and also frame in the picture/window context -- only surrounding text disambiguates.
samples.hypothesis: "Frame" refers to "frame" in the coding domain, and also "frame" in the window/frame domain, distinguished by context.

samples.source: sample 在音频域是 "样本 / 采样点"，在统计域是 "样本 / 抽样单位"。
samples.reference: Sample in audio is a discrete sample; in statistics it is a sampled unit -- the English word is the same.
samples.hypothesis: Sample in the audio domain is "sample / sampling point", and in the statistical domain is "sample / sampling unit".

samples.source: model 在 ML 域是 "模型"，在时尚/模型汽车域也是 "model"。
samples.reference: Model in machine learning is a trained predictor; in fashion or scale cars it is also a model.
samples.hypothesis: Model refers to "model" in the ML domain, and also means "model" in the fashion/model car domain.

samples.source: pitch 在语音域是 "音高"，在棒球域是 "投球"，在商务域是 "提案"。
samples.reference: Pitch in speech is fundamental frequency; in baseball it is a throw; in business it is a proposal.
samples.hypothesis: Pitch in the speech domain is "pitch", in the baseball domain is "pitching", and in the business domain is "proposal".

samples.source: prosody 只在语音学域用，其他语境几乎不出现，可作纯领域锚点。
samples.reference: Prosody appears only in phonetics -- a pure domain anchor.
samples.hypothesis: Prosody is used only in the field of phonetics and appears almost nowhere else, making it a pure domain anchor.

samples.source: vocoder 是语音工程独有的 "声码器"，普通用户不认识，UI 中要加解释。
samples.reference: Vocoder is unique to speech engineering ("声码器"); most users will not recognise it, so the UI has to explain.
samples.hypothesis: The vocoder is a unique "vocoder" in speech engineering, which ordinary users are not familiar with, so an explanation should be added in the UI.

samples.source: diarization 是 "说话人分离"，与 recognition 组合成 "谁在什么时候说了什么"。
samples.reference: Diarization means speaker separation; combined with recognition it answers "who said what when".
samples.hypothesis: Diarization is "speaker diarization", which is combined with recognition to form "who said what and when".

samples.source: alignment 在字幕域是 "对齐"，在 NLP 域是 "对齐（跨语言）"，在几何域是 "排列"。
samples.reference: Alignment in subtitle context is temporal alignment; in NLP it is cross-lingual alignment; in geometry it is arrangement.
samples.hypothesis: Alignment in the subtitle domain is "alignment", in the NLP domain is "alignment (cross-language)", and in the geometry domain is "arrangement".

samples.source: decoder 在编解码域是 "解码器"，在神经机器翻译域也是解码器，两侧含义相关但实现不同。
samples.reference: Decoder is a hardware or software component in the codec sense, and also the second half of an NMT model -- related meaning, different implementation.
samples.hypothesis: The decoder is "decoder" in the coding domain, and also "decoder" in the neural machine translation domain. The meanings on both sides are related but the implementations differ.

samples.source: encoder 与 decoder 对称；神经网络里两侧都用同名，工程里可能一个是软件一个是硬件。
samples.reference: Encoder and decoder are symmetric; in neural networks both share the name, but in engineering one may be software and the other hardware.
samples.hypothesis: Encoder and decoder are symmetric; in neural networks, both sides use the same name, but in engineering, one might be software and the other hardware.

samples.source: codec 是 encoder + decoder 的合体，通常只在压缩域使用。
samples.reference: A codec is encoder plus decoder fused; the word is usually restricted to the compression domain.
samples.hypothesis: A codec is a combination of encoder and decoder, and is typically used only in the compressed domain.

samples.source: container 在视频工程是 "容器格式"（mkv/mp4），在软件部署是 "容器"（Docker）。
samples.reference: In video engineering a container is a container format (mkv/mp4); in software deployment a container is a Docker container.
samples.hypothesis: In video engineering, "container" refers to "container format" (mkv/mp4), while in software deployment, it refers to "container" (Docker).

samples.source: latency 在实时音视频是网络与解码延迟总和；在计算体系结构里是流水线延迟。
samples.reference: In real-time audio and video, latency is the sum of network and decoding delays; in computer architecture it is pipeline latency.
samples.hypothesis: Latency in real-time audio and video is the sum of network and decoding latency; in computing architecture, it is pipeline latency.

samples.source: jitter 在网络语境是 "抖动"，在时钟语境也是 "抖动"，两者机制不同要区分。
samples.reference: Jitter means network jitter in one context and clock jitter in another -- the mechanisms differ and translation must separate them.
samples.hypothesis: Jitter means "jitter" in the network context and also "jitter" in the clock context, but the mechanisms are different and should be distinguished.

samples.source: throughput 与 bandwidth 常被混用；前者是实际吞吐，后者是理论上限。
samples.reference: Throughput and bandwidth are often conflated; the first is achieved work, the second is the theoretical ceiling.
samples.hypothesis: Throughput and bandwidth are often used interchangeably; the former refers to actual throughput, while the latter represents the theoretical upper limit.

samples.source: chunk 与 packet 与 frame 在流媒体里是三个不同粒度，翻译不能一律译成 "块"。
samples.reference: Chunk, packet and frame are three different granularities in streaming media and cannot all be translated as "块".
samples.hypothesis: Chunk, packet and frame are three different granularities in streaming media, and they should not be translated as "block" uniformly.

samples.source: prompt 在 LLM 域是 "提示词"，在 OS 终端域是 "命令提示符"，两者完全不同。
samples.reference: In the LLM domain a prompt is an instruction to the model; in the OS shell it is a command prompt -- entirely different meanings.
samples.hypothesis: The term "prompt" is "prompt" in the LLM domain and "command prompt" in the OS terminal domain, which are completely different.

samples.source: token 在 NLP 域是 "词元"，在身份认证域是 "令牌"。
samples.reference: A token in NLP is a subword unit; in authentication it is an access token.
samples.hypothesis: Token is "token" in the NLP domain and "token" in the identity authentication domain.

samples.source: transcode 是重新编码；remux 是只重封装不重编码，两者的画质损失完全不同。
samples.reference: Transcode re-encodes; remux only rewraps. Their quality loss profiles differ fundamentally.
samples.hypothesis: Transcoding is re-encoding; remuxing is only re-packaging without re-encoding, and the quality loss between the two is completely different.

samples.source: burn-in 是硬字幕化，overlay 是叠加显示，两者在渲染管线上不同。
samples.reference: Burn-in hard-codes subtitles into the pixels; overlay draws them at render time. They sit at different stages of the pipeline.
samples.hypothesis: Burn-in is subtitle hardcoding, overlay is overlay display, the two are different in the rendering pipeline.

samples.source: 录音时先检查麦克风增益再检查系统音量，避免底噪被算法当语音。
samples.reference: When recording, check microphone gain before system volume -- clipping at the input cannot be undone by any algorithm.
samples.hypothesis: Check the microphone gain and system volume before recording to avoid background noise being mistaken for speech by the algorithm.

samples.source: 扬声器切换在 Windows 上需要重启音频图，多数应用会掉一帧。
samples.reference: Switching the output speaker on Windows rebuilds the audio graph, and many applications drop a frame during the change.
samples.hypothesis: Switching the loudspeaker on Windows requires restarting the audio graph, causing most applications to drop a frame.

samples.source: 播放条拖动要显式触发关键帧 seek，不然会看到花屏过渡。
samples.reference: Dragging the playhead should explicitly seek to a keyframe; otherwise viewers see a block of corrupted frames during the transition.
samples.hypothesis: Dragging the playback bar should explicitly trigger keyframe seek, otherwise you will see a screen tearing transition.

samples.source: 预览窗口默认按软字幕渲染，导出时可以选择烧进画面。
samples.reference: The preview pane renders soft subtitles by default; hard-burn is an explicit export option.
samples.hypothesis: The preview window defaults to rendering soft subtitles, and you can choose to burn them into the picture when exporting.

samples.source: 时间轴面板支持逐帧微调，用左右方向键可以一帧一帧移动。
samples.reference: The timeline panel supports frame-level nudge -- left and right arrows step exactly one frame.
samples.hypothesis: Timeline panel supports frame-by-frame fine-tuning, and you can move frame by frame using the left and right arrow keys.

samples.source: 剪辑导出前要先做静音剪裁，不然成片里会有无意义空白。
samples.reference: Cut silence before exporting an edit, otherwise the final piece has meaningless gaps.
samples.hypothesis: Before exporting, you should first do silence trimming, otherwise there will be meaningless blank spaces in the final product.

samples.source: 导入 AV 素材时最好显式选择帧率解释策略，跨制式素材容易掉帧。
samples.reference: When importing AV footage, explicitly pick the frame-rate interpretation policy -- mixed-source clips drop frames otherwise.
samples.hypothesis: Import AV materials and choose frame rate interpretation strategy explicitly. Cross-standard materials are prone to dropped frames.

samples.source: 音频波形视图可以让用户手工微调 VAD 段边界，识别错切时特别有用。
samples.reference: The waveform view lets the user hand-tune VAD boundaries, which is invaluable when the auto-segmentation mis-cuts.
samples.hypothesis: The audio waveform view allows users to manually fine-tune the boundaries of VAD segments, which is particularly useful for identifying errors.

samples.source: 导出双语字幕时两个轨要用独立时间戳，不要共用一个。
samples.reference: When exporting bilingual subtitles, keep independent timestamps for each track -- sharing one drifts fast.
samples.hypothesis: Export bilingual subtitles with two tracks using independent timestamps, do not share one timestamp.

samples.source: 预览延迟过高的机器可以把 VAD 阈值调松，让用户先看到大致分段。
samples.reference: On machines with high preview latency, loosen the VAD threshold so users see the rough segmentation before refining.
samples.hypothesis: Machines with high preview latency can adjust the VAD threshold to a looser setting, allowing users to see a rough segmentation first.

samples.source: 导入音频时检测采样率与位深，不匹配时给出重采样建议而不是静默转换。
samples.reference: Detect sample rate and bit depth on import; if they mismatch, offer a resampling choice instead of silently converting.
samples.hypothesis: Detect sample rate and bit depth when importing audio, and provide resampling suggestions instead of silent conversion when they are mismatched.

samples.source: 本地引擎矩阵覆盖 argos、madlad、ollama 三个真实引擎，加一个内置 demo 兜底。
samples.reference: The local engine matrix covers three real engines -- argos, madlad and ollama -- plus a built-in demo as the last fallback.
samples.hypothesis: The local engine matrix covers three real engines: argos, madlad, and ollama, plus an embedded demo as a backup.

samples.source: sidecar 只监听 127.0.0.1 保证隐私不变量：任何外部进程都不能访问这台机器上的翻译流。
samples.reference: The sidecar binds only to 127.0.0.1 to enforce the privacy invariant: no external process can touch this machine's translation stream.
samples.hypothesis: sidecar listens only to 127.0.0.1 to ensure privacy invariants: no external process can access the translation stream on this machine.

samples.source: 语言对是本地模型分档的核心维度，同一模型在不同语言对上质量差 15 分以上。
samples.reference: Language-pair tiering decides which engine runs; some cold pairs have no local engine at all.
samples.hypothesis: Language pair is the core dimension for model tiering. The quality difference of the same model across different language pairs can be more than 15 points.

samples.source: 交付离线整合包时要把模型权重、词表、配置文件一起打包，避免用户首启动还要联网下载。
samples.reference: When delivering the offline bundle, ship weights, vocabularies and configuration together -- the user's first launch should not need network access.
samples.hypothesis: When delivering the offline bundle, package the model weights, vocabulary, and configuration files together to avoid the user needing to download them again via the network during the first startup.

samples.source: 精译档与实时档不是 "快慢" 之别，而是 "预算" 之别：一个允许升级 AI，一个不允许。
samples.reference: Quality mode and realtime mode differ not in speed but in budget: one permits AI upgrade, the other does not.
samples.hypothesis: Quality mode and realtime mode are not a matter of "speed" but "budget": one allows upgrading AI, and the other does not.

samples.source: 质量偏好开关影响精译档的升级策略，可以在 "质量优先" 与 "省成本优先" 之间二选一。
samples.reference: The quality-preference toggle steers the upgrade policy of quality mode, choosing between "quality first" and "cost first".
samples.hypothesis: The quality preference switch affects the upgrade policy of the quality mode, allowing you to choose between "Quality First" and "Cost Saving First".

samples.source: 兜底降级会明确说明 "该语言对未装本地模型"，让用户去下载而不是误以为产品坏了。
samples.reference: Fallback states explicitly that "the local model for this pair is missing", prompting the user to download rather than assume the product is broken.
samples.hypothesis: Fallback degradation will clearly state "the language pair does not have a local model installed", prompting the user to download it instead of mistakenly thinking the product is broken.

samples.source: 翻译流水线的每一层判定都可观测：TM 命中、隐私钳制、语言对分档、本地引擎、AI 升级、置信度门控。
samples.reference: Every layer of the translation pipeline is observable: TM hit, privacy clamp, language-pair tiering, local engine, AI upgrade and confidence gating.
samples.hypothesis: Each layer of the pipeline is observable: TM hit, privacy constraints, language pair tiering, local engine, AI upgrade, confidence gating.

samples.source: 模型许可矩阵是产品对外承诺的一部分，Silero MIT、SenseVoice MIT、Kokoro Apache-2.0、Argos MIT 全绿。
samples.reference: The model-licence matrix is part of the outward commitment -- Silero MIT, SenseVoice MIT, Kokoro Apache-2.0 and Argos MIT all clear.
samples.hypothesis: The model licensing matrix is part of the product's commitment to the outside world, with Silero MIT, SenseVoice MIT, Kokoro Apache-2.0, and Argos MIT all green.

samples.source: 执行提供程序按操作系统分层：Windows 首选 CUDA 或 DirectML，macOS 首选 CoreML，Linux 首选 CUDA。
samples.reference: Execution providers are tiered by operating system: Windows prefers CUDA or DirectML, macOS prefers CoreML, Linux prefers CUDA.
samples.hypothesis: Execution providers are layered by operating system: Windows prefers CUDA or DirectML, macOS prefers CoreML, and Linux prefers CUDA.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译的训练目标是最小化交叉熵，与人类直觉的 "信达雅" 不完全重合。
samples.reference: The training target of neural machine translation is to minimise cross-entropy, which only partially aligns with the human intuition of "faithfulness, expressiveness, elegance".
samples.hypothesis: The training objective of neural machine translation is to minimize cross-entropy, which does not fully align with human intuition of "faithfulness, fluency, and elegance."

samples.source: 翻译记忆与术语表解决的是不同问题：前者复用整句历史，后者约束单词译法。
samples.reference: Translation memory and glossary solve different problems: the first reuses whole-sentence history, the second constrains word-level rendering.
samples.hypothesis: Translation memory and glossary address different issues: the former reuses historical sentences, while the latter constrains word translation.

samples.source: 置信度分数应该跟译文本身绑定，而不是跟引擎绑定；同一模型不同批次的输出置信度会漂移。
samples.reference: Confidence should be bound to the translation itself, not to the engine -- the same model can drift across batches.
samples.hypothesis: The confidence score should be tied to the translation output rather than the engine; the confidence of the same model across different batches may drift.

samples.source: 兜底降级路径要保留请求上下文，让下一层能知道上一层为什么没走通。
samples.reference: A fallback path must preserve request context so the next layer can see why the previous one did not run.
samples.hypothesis: The fallback degradation path should retain the request context so that the lower layer can understand why the upper layer failed to proceed.

samples.source: 不静默降级要求响应 message 字段携带完整原因链，调用方据此决定重试还是提示用户。
samples.reference: No-silent-degradation requires the response message to carry the full causal chain so the caller can decide to retry or prompt the user.
samples.hypothesis: No silent degradation requires the response message field to carry the complete cause chain, allowing the caller to decide whether to retry or prompt the user.

samples.source: 上下文窗口是 LLM 硬约束，长文档翻译要么截断要么按句喂，不能整段塞进去。
samples.reference: The context window is a hard constraint on the LLM; long documents must be truncated or fed one sentence at a time, never stuffed whole.
samples.hypothesis: The context window is a hard constraint for LLMs. Long document translation either gets truncated or processed sentence by sentence, and the entire paragraph cannot be fed in at once.

samples.source: 少样本示例条数不是越多越好，5 条高质量示例往往优于 20 条低质量示例。
samples.reference: More few-shot examples are not always better -- five high-quality examples often beat twenty low-quality ones.
samples.hypothesis: The number of few-shot examples is not necessarily better with more; often, 5 high-quality examples are better than 20 low-quality ones.

samples.source: 蒸馏的入库阈值决定了术语表的信噪比，太松会让错误术语污染后续所有请求。
samples.reference: The distillation store threshold determines glossary signal-to-noise; too permissive lets wrong terms pollute every subsequent request.
samples.hypothesis: The distillation's入库 threshold determines the signal-to-noise ratio of the glossary. Too loose will allow erroneous terms to contaminate all subsequent requests.

samples.source: 术语注入到提示词中要显式约束格式，不然模型会把中文术语当成解释性文本。
samples.reference: Term injection into the prompt must specify format explicitly, otherwise the model reads the Chinese terms as explanatory prose.
samples.hypothesis: Term injection into the prompt should explicitly constrain the format, otherwise the model will treat Chinese terms as explanatory text.

samples.source: 多语言模型对冷门语言对的表现受限于训练语料规模，不是模型容量。
samples.reference: A multilingual model's performance on cold pairs is bound by training corpus size, not model capacity.
samples.hypothesis: Performance of multilingual models on less common language pairs is limited by the scale of training data, not model capacity.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译的分词器与训练语料绑定，跨语料使用时词表命中率会骤降。
samples.reference: Neural machine translation's tokenizer is bound to its training corpus; using it on a different corpus makes the vocabulary hit rate collapse.
samples.hypothesis: The tokenizer of neural machine translation is bound to the training corpus. When used across different corpora, the hit rate of the vocabulary drops sharply.

samples.source: 大语言模型可以做机器翻译，但对提示工程敏感，同一个源句换个提示可能质量差一档。
samples.reference: A large language model can do machine translation but is sensitive to prompt engineering -- the same source sentence can differ by a tier depending on the prompt.
samples.hypothesis: Large language models can perform machine translation, but they are sensitive to prompt engineering. The same source sentence may result in a quality drop if the prompt is changed.

samples.source: 自动评测不能替代人工评测；chrF/BLEU 与 COMET 与人工评分之间相关系数在窄域上会明显下降。
samples.reference: Automatic evaluation cannot replace human evaluation; on narrow domains the correlation between chrF/BLEU/COMET and human judgement drops noticeably.
samples.hypothesis: Automatic evaluation cannot replace human evaluation; the correlation between chrF/BLEU and COMET with human scores significantly decreases in narrow domains.

samples.source: 统计机器翻译的短语表在语序差异大的语对之间退化严重，比如中文到芬兰语。
samples.reference: Phrase tables in statistical machine translation degrade badly for pairs with large word-order gaps, e.g. Chinese to Finnish.
samples.hypothesis: The phrase table of statistical machine translation deteriorates seriously between language pairs with significant word order differences, such as Chinese to Finnish.

samples.source: 翻译记忆的模糊匹配按编辑距离或语义距离排序，返回的 top-k 数量要克制。
samples.reference: Fuzzy match over translation memory sorts by edit distance or semantic distance; the returned top-k must stay small to avoid noise.
samples.hypothesis: Fuzzy matches in translation memory are sorted by edit distance or semantic distance, and the number of top-k results should be controlled.

samples.source: 置信度门控在实时档要更严，因为实时档不接受升级；在精译档可以稍松，因为 AI 兜底。
samples.reference: Confidence gating has to be stricter in realtime mode because realtime does not allow upgrade, and looser in quality mode because AI provides a floor.
samples.hypothesis: Confidence gating is stricter in realtime mode because realtime mode does not allow upgrades; in quality mode it can be slightly looser because AI serves as a fallback.

samples.source: 术语注入到本地引擎与注入到 LLM 的效果不一样：本地引擎把它当硬约束，LLM 会理解上下文再决定。
samples.reference: Term injection behaves differently on local engines versus LLMs: local treats it as a hard constraint, LLMs integrate it into context before deciding.
samples.hypothesis: Term injection into the local engine is different from injection into the LLM: the local engine treats it as a hard constraint, while the LLM decides based on context understanding.

samples.source: 蒸馏产出要区分 "用户已确认" 与 "机器自抽"，前者可以覆盖后者，反之不行。
samples.reference: Distillation output must distinguish "user confirmed" from "machine extracted"; the first can overwrite the second, not the other way round.
samples.hypothesis: Distillation output should distinguish between "user confirmed" and "machine self-draw", where the former can override the latter, but not vice versa.

samples.source: 命中率与延迟之间通常正相关；命中率越高说明重复内容越多，缓存路径也越快。
samples.reference: Hit rate and latency are usually positively correlated -- a higher hit rate means more repeated content and faster cached paths.
samples.hypothesis: Hit rate and latency are typically positively correlated; a higher hit rate indicates more repeated content and faster cache paths.

samples.source: 端到端语音翻译里 ASR 的错误会传染给 MT，再传染给 TTS，因此段级评估要独立跑。
samples.reference: In end-to-end speech translation, ASR errors propagate into MT and then into TTS, so segment-level evaluation has to run independently.
samples.hypothesis: Errors in ASR can spread to MT and then to TTS in end-to-end speech translation, therefore segment-level evaluation should be run independently.

samples.source: 神经机器翻译的注意力可视化能揭示模型 "看到" 了源句的哪一部分，但不等于可解释性。
samples.reference: Attention visualisation reveals which part of the source the model "looked at" but is not the same as interpretability.
samples.hypothesis: The visualization of attention in neural machine translation can reveal which part of the source sentence the model "sees," but it is not equivalent to interpretability.

samples.source: 翻译记忆的更新策略是 last-write-wins 还是 best-quality-wins，产品语义完全不同。
