samples.hypothesis: Disabling network connectivity should take effect at the configuration layer overall, rather than intercepting each individual network call point.

samples.source: 用户清空记忆库要连带清除派生的术语条目，否则残留仍会回显。
samples.reference: Clearing the translation memory must also clear term rows derived from it, or they keep resurfacing.
samples.hypothesis: When users clear the memory database, they should also delete derived term entries, otherwise residual data will still be displayed.

samples.source: 现场部署的机器没有外网，安装介质要自带全部依赖与校验和。
samples.reference: A site machine has no outbound access, so the media must carry every dependency and its checksum.
samples.hypothesis: The machines deployed on-site have no access to the internet, so the installation media must include all dependencies and checksums.

samples.source: 版本回滚要能连带回滚术语表与记忆库结构，避免旧版读坏新格式。
samples.reference: A rollback must cover the glossary and memory schema, or an old build misreads a new format.
samples.hypothesis: Version rollback should be able to roll back the glossary and memory database structure, avoiding old versions reading new formats.

samples.source: 许可审计要覆盖运行时才出现的依赖声明，不只是构建清单里的。
samples.reference: The licence audit must cover dependencies that appear only at runtime, not just the build manifest.
samples.hypothesis: License audit should cover dependency declarations that appear at runtime, not just those in the build manifest.

samples.source: 敏感素材要按项目隔离记忆库，避免跨项目串味。
samples.reference: Keep separate memory stores per project for sensitive material, to avoid cross-project bleed.
samples.hypothesis: Sensitive materials should be isolated in separate memory libraries by project to avoid cross-project contamination.

samples.source: 诊断接口在隐私模式下也要可用，它自身不得发出网络请求。
samples.reference: The diagnostics endpoint must stay available under privacy mode and issue no requests itself.
samples.hypothesis: The diagnostic interface must be available in privacy mode, and it should not make any network requests on its own.

samples.source: 禁用云引擎后仍要如实说明结果来自本地，不让人误以为已升级。
samples.reference: After disabling cloud engines, still state plainly that the result is local rather than implying an upgrade.
samples.hypothesis: After disabling the cloud engine, still truthfully state that the results come from the local machine to prevent people from mistakenly thinking that an upgrade has been made.

samples.source: 现场排障的日志级别要能临时提升并自动回落，避免长期输出细节。
samples.reference: On-site log levels should be raised temporarily and revert, rather than emitting detail forever.
samples.hypothesis: The log level for on-site troubleshooting should be temporarily increased and automatically reverted to avoid long-term output of detailed information.

samples.source: 交付前的检查清单要包含字体、编码与语言代码三项一致性。
samples.reference: A pre-delivery checklist must cover consistency of font, encoding and language code.
samples.hypothesis: The checklist before delivery should include consistency in fonts, encoding, and language code.

samples.source: 批量任务的中断与续跑按片段记录进度，不保留原文正文。
samples.reference: Record resume progress per segment for batch jobs, without keeping the source text.
samples.hypothesis: Interrupted and resumed batch tasks record progress in segments, without retaining the original text content.

samples.source: 访问控制未实现前，对外服务面必须保持为本机回环。
samples.reference: Until access control exists, the exposed service surface must stay loopback-only.
samples.hypothesis: Before access control is implemented, the external service plane must remain as the local loopback.

samples.source: 术语表按领域发布时不得携带用户私有条目。
samples.reference: A published domain glossary must not carry a user's private rows.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary shall not include user private entries when released by domain.

samples.source: 导出包要能出具内容清单，供客户方核对是否含敏感字段。
samples.reference: Export bundles should ship a manifest so the customer can check for sensitive fields.
samples.hypothesis: The exported package should be able to provide a content list for the customer to verify whether it contains sensitive fields.

samples.source: 遥测默认关闭比默认开启加开关更安全，误操作的成本不对称。
samples.reference: Telemetry off by default is safer than on by default with a switch; the cost of a mistake is asymmetric.
samples.hypothesis: Telemetry default off is safer than default on with a switch, as the cost of accidental operation is asymmetric.

samples.source: 文档示例要用合成素材，不能直接粘贴客户真实稿件。
samples.reference: Use synthetic material in docs, never a client's real transcript.
samples.hypothesis: The document examples should use synthetic materials and cannot directly paste the customer's real documents.

samples.source: 密钥与访问令牌不写入仓库，包括测试用的假值。
samples.reference: Keep keys and tokens out of the repository, including fake ones used in tests.
samples.hypothesis: The keys and access tokens are not written to the repository, including the fake values used for testing.

samples.source: 清除数据要给出可核对的完成回执，而不是静默返回成功。
samples.reference: Clearing data must return a verifiable receipt rather than a bare success.
samples.hypothesis: Clear data should provide a verifiable completion receipt instead of silently returning success.

samples.source: 离线环境的模型获取要能校验来源，避免下载链路成为攻击面。
samples.reference: Verify model provenance in offline environments, so the download path does not become the attack surface.
samples.hypothesis: Model acquisition in offline environments should be able to verify the source to prevent the download chain from becoming an attack surface.

samples.source: 合规检查里最容易被忽略的是导出文件的元数据字段。
samples.reference: The metadata fields of exported files are the most overlooked compliance item.
samples.hypothesis: The metadata fields of the exported file are often the easiest to overlook in compliance checks.

samples.source: 客户现场的问题复现要用最小样本，避免整批素材外流。
samples.reference: Reproduce field issues with a minimal sample, so a whole batch never leaves the site.
samples.hypothesis: Reproducing the customer's on-site issue should use the minimal sample to avoid leaking the entire material.

samples.source: 权限分级未实现前，共享终端上的记忆库要按目录隔离。
samples.reference: Until roles exist, isolate memory stores by directory on shared terminals.
samples.hypothesis: Before permission grading was implemented, the knowledge base on shared terminals should be isolated by directory.

samples.source: 审计日志的保留期要与交付合同一致，不默认长期保存。
samples.reference: Align audit retention with the delivery contract instead of keeping records by default.
samples.hypothesis: The retention period of audit logs should be consistent with the delivery contract and should not default to long-term storage.

samples.source: 删除操作的语义要区分逻辑标记与物理清除，两者不可混写。
samples.reference: Separate logical flagging from physical erasure in delete operations.
samples.hypothesis: The semantics of the delete operation should distinguish between logical marking and physical deletion, and they should not be mixed.

samples.source: 敏感域的评测样本不能出现在公开基准里。
samples.reference: Sensitive-domain evaluation samples cannot appear in a public benchmark.
samples.hypothesis: The evaluation samples of sensitive domains cannot appear in public benchmarks.

samples.source: 交付前要把用户数据目录从打包产物中排除并复核。
samples.reference: Exclude and re-check the user data directory from packaged artefacts before delivery.
samples.hypothesis: Exclude the user data directory from the delivery package and verify it again before delivery.

samples.source: 本地化项目交接时，术语表与记忆库要分别签署授权范围。
samples.reference: On project handover, sign the scope for the glossary and the memory store separately.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary and memory bank should be signed with separate authorization scopes during the handover of a localization project.

samples.source: 隐私不变量由测试锁死比由文档承诺更可靠。
samples.reference: Privacy invariants held by a test are worth more than privacy promises in a document.
samples.hypothesis: Privacy invariants are more reliable than test lock-in ratios committed by documentation.

samples.source: 被禁用的功能要在界面上明说被禁用，而不是隐藏入口。
samples.reference: Disable a feature visibly, rather than hiding its entry point.
samples.hypothesis: Disabled functions should be clearly indicated as disabled on the interface, rather than hiding their entry points.

samples.source: 客户环境的网络代理会改变探测结论，检查要区分不可达与未配置。
samples.reference: A customer's proxy changes probe results, so separate unreachable from unconfigured.
samples.hypothesis: The network proxy in the customer's environment can change the detection result; check to distinguish between unreachable and unconfigured.

samples.source: 默认配置要选保守的一档，把放开选项写进需要显式操作的地方。
samples.reference: Ship the conservative default and require an explicit action to loosen it.
samples.hypothesis: Default configuration should select a conservative setting, and write the unrestrictive options in places where explicit operations are required.

samples.source: 导出失败时不要把部分文件留在目标目录，先写临时再改名。
samples.reference: Leave no partial file behind on export failure: write to a staging name then rename.
samples.hypothesis: Do not leave partial files in the target directory when export fails; first write to a temporary file and then rename it.

samples.source: 临时文件的名称必须唯一，固定名在并发下会互相删错。
samples.reference: Staging names must be unique; a fixed one deletes the wrong file under concurrency.
samples.hypothesis: The name of temporary files must be unique, fixed names will delete each other under concurrency.

samples.source: 断网演练要覆盖首次安装，验证没有隐藏的外部请求。
samples.reference: Run a disconnected drill of first install to prove no hidden outbound requests exist.
samples.hypothesis: The network outage drill should cover the first installation and verify there are no hidden external requests.

samples.source: 模型文件的完整性校验要包含大小与摘要两项。
samples.reference: Integrity checking of model files should cover both size and digest.
samples.hypothesis: The integrity check of the model file should include size and hash.

samples.source: 现场版本升级要能只回滚配置而不丢用户已确认的术语。
samples.reference: A field upgrade must be able to roll back config alone, keeping confirmed terms.
samples.hypothesis: The on-site version upgrade should be able to roll back only the configuration without losing the user's confirmed terminology.

samples.source: 可复核性要求日志能指出决策来自哪一层，而不是只给结果。
samples.reference: Logs must name the layer a decision came from, not just the outcome.
samples.hypothesis: The audibility requirement demands that logs indicate the source layer of a decision, rather than just providing the result.

samples.source: 数据出境受限时，云端引擎即便可达也不得进入路由。
samples.reference: When data may not leave the country, cloud engines stay out of routing even if reachable.
samples.hypothesis: When data出境 is restricted, the cloud engine cannot enter the routing even if it is reachable.

samples.source: 交付包的哈希与版本号一起记录，便于追溯现场实际装了什么。
samples.reference: Record the delivery package's digest with its version to trace what was installed.
samples.hypothesis: The hash of the delivery package is recorded together with the version number to facilitate tracing what was actually installed on-site.

samples.source: 删除记忆库后术语表仍可能被蒸馏回填，要能关闭该通路。
samples.reference: After clearing the memory, term harvesting can still refill it, so allow closing that path.
samples.hypothesis: After deleting the knowledge base, the glossary may still be distilled back in, so this pathway should be able to be closed.

samples.source: 用户确认过的条目要能标注为不可再分发。
samples.reference: Rows a user confirmed can be marked non-redistributable.
samples.hypothesis: Entries confirmed by users should be able to be marked as non-distributable.

samples.source: 内部构建产物要能整体签名，安全策略才会放行加载。
samples.reference: Internal build artefacts need full signing, or platform security blocks loading.
samples.hypothesis: The internally built artifacts must be able to be signed as a whole, so the security policy will allow loading.

samples.source: 评估一份交付风险要看数据流向而不是看功能数量。
samples.reference: Judge delivery risk by where data flows, not by how many features exist.
samples.hypothesis: Assessing delivery risk should focus on the data stream rather than the number of features.

samples.source: 交付离线整合包时要一次带上引擎、模型、词表与校验清单。
samples.reference: An offline bundle ships the engine, models, vocabularies and a checksum manifest together.
samples.hypothesis: Delivery of the offline bundle should include the engine, model, vocabulary, and checklist all at once.

samples.source: 安装包要能在无管理员权限下装到用户目录。
samples.reference: The installer must work into a user directory without elevation.
samples.hypothesis: The installation package should be able to install into the user's directory without administrator privileges.

samples.source: 构建产物全部签名，否则系统的应用控制会拦截本地加载。
samples.reference: Sign every build artefact, or platform application control blocks local loading.
samples.hypothesis: All built artifacts must be signed; otherwise, the system's application control will block local loading.

samples.source: 安装路径含非拉丁字符时，动态库加载要能正确解析。
samples.reference: Handle non-Latin characters in the install path when loading the native library.
samples.hypothesis: When the installation path contains non-Latin characters, the dynamic library loading should be able to parse correctly.

samples.source: 升级安装要保留用户数据目录，并迁移其结构版本。
samples.reference: An upgrade keeps the user data directory and migrates its schema version.
samples.hypothesis: Upgrade installation should retain the user data directory and migrate its structure version.

samples.source: 卸载时数据目录的处置要显式询问，不默认删除。
samples.reference: Ask what to do with the data directory on uninstall; never delete by default.
samples.hypothesis: The disposal of the data directory during uninstallation should be explicitly asked, not deleted by default.

samples.source: 打包脚本要列出被收录的二进制清单，避免漏签与漏装。
samples.reference: The packaging step should enumerate included binaries, so nothing is unsigned or missing.
samples.hypothesis: The packaging script should list the included binary files to avoid missing signatures and installations.

samples.source: 绿色版与安装版共用同一份配置解析规则，避免行为分叉。
samples.reference: Keep one config resolution rule across portable and installed forms, or behaviour forks.
samples.hypothesis: The green version and the installation version share the same configuration parsing rules to avoid divergent behaviors.

samples.source: 运行时依赖版本要锁定，浮动的次版本会改变推理结果。
samples.reference: Pin runtime dependency versions; a floating minor version can change inference output.
samples.hypothesis: Runtime dependencies' versions should be locked; floating sub-versions can change the inference results.

samples.source: 构建机与开发机不一致时，以可复现的干净环境为准。
samples.reference: When build and dev machines differ, the clean reproducible one is authoritative.
samples.hypothesis: When the build machine and development machine are inconsistent, the reproducible clean environment is taken as the standard.

samples.source: 交付清单要写清哪些模型需另行获取，避免装机后才发现缺件。
samples.reference: State which models must be fetched separately, so a gap is not found after installation.
samples.hypothesis: Specify in the delivery list which models need to be obtained separately to avoid discovering missing parts after installation.

samples.source: 打包体积增长要能归因到具体新增项，别只报总大小。
samples.reference: Attribute growth in package size to a specific addition, rather than reporting a total.
samples.hypothesis: The increase in package size should be attributable to specific new items, not just the total size.

samples.source: 安装后自检要覆盖动态库加载与模型可读两项。
samples.reference: A post-install self-check must cover loading the native library and reading a model.
samples.hypothesis: The self-check after installation should cover dynamic library loading and model readability.

samples.source: 现场无外网时，更新机制要支持离线补丁包。
samples.reference: With no outbound access, the update path must accept an offline patch package.
samples.hypothesis: When there is no external network available, the update mechanism should support offline patch packages.

samples.source: 配置热更新未实现前，改配置要能在文档里指明需重启哪一层。
samples.reference: Until hot reload exists, document which layer a config change restarts.
samples.hypothesis: Before the configuration of hot update is implemented, the configuration should indicate which layer needs to be restarted in the document.

samples.source: 崩溃报告默认不收集正文，只收集调用位置与版本。
samples.reference: Crash reports collect location and version by default, never the text.
samples.hypothesis: The crash report defaults to not collecting the body, only collecting the call location and version.

samples.source: 打包时排除缓存目录，避免把开发机的记忆库一起发出去。
samples.reference: Exclude cache directories when packaging, so a developer's memory store is never shipped.
samples.hypothesis: Exclude the cache directory when packaging to avoid sending the development machine's cache together.

samples.source: 双平台各配一个薄壳入口，逻辑只放在脚本主体里。
samples.reference: Keep one thin launcher per OS and put the logic in the shared script.
samples.hypothesis: Each platform has its own thin shell entrance, and the logic is only placed in the main script.

samples.source: 构建脚本要能只跳过已完成且哈希未变的阶段。
samples.reference: The build script must skip a stage whose inputs are unchanged by digest.
samples.hypothesis: The build script should be able to skip stages that have already been completed and whose hashes have not changed.

samples.source: 干净构建要能一条命令复现，避免依赖历史产物。
samples.reference: A clean build must be reproducible with one command, without relying on prior artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: A clean build should be reproducible with a single command, avoiding reliance on historical artifacts.

samples.source: 版本信息要在界面与诊断接口一致显示。
samples.reference: Show the same version string in the UI and in diagnostics.
samples.hypothesis: The version information should be displayed consistently on the interface and diagnostic interface.

samples.source: 交付物要包含许可矩阵，覆盖随包分发的一切第三方成分。
samples.reference: Ship a licence matrix covering every third-party component in the package.
samples.hypothesis: The deliverables must include a license matrix covering all third-party components distributed with the package.

samples.source: 模型文件过大时按语言对拆分下载，避免首装全量拉取。
samples.reference: Split model downloads per language pair so a first install fetches nothing wholesale.
samples.hypothesis: Split download by language pair when model file is too large to avoid pulling the full model during initial installation.

samples.source: 装机脚本要幂等，重复执行不产生第二份配置。
samples.reference: Keep install scripting idempotent; running it twice must not create a second config.
samples.hypothesis: The installation script should be idempotent, so that repeated execution does not produce a second set of configurations.

samples.source: 安装失败要留下可读的原因文件，而不是只有弹窗。
samples.reference: On failure leave a readable reason file, not just a dialog.
samples.hypothesis: The failure to install should leave a readable reason file instead of only a popup.

samples.source: 现场排障优先加诊断输出，而不是先改代码复现。
samples.reference: Prefer extra diagnostics when debugging in the field, rather than editing code to reproduce it.
samples.hypothesis: On-site troubleshooting should prioritize adding diagnostic output first, rather than modifying code to reproduce the issue.

samples.source: 打包链路的每一步产物都要有校验和，避免半传文件进入安装。
samples.reference: Checksum every stage of the packaging chain so a truncated file never reaches an installer.
samples.hypothesis: Each product in the packaging chain should have a checksum to prevent partially transferred files from being installed.

samples.source: 交付版本与仓库提交要能一一对应，便于事后追溯。
samples.reference: Map each delivered version to a repository commit for later tracing.
samples.hypothesis: Delivery versions should correspond one-to-one with repository commits to facilitate traceability later.

samples.source: 默认数据目录的解析规则要在各语言绑定之间保持一致。
samples.reference: Keep the default data-directory rule identical across bindings.
samples.hypothesis: The parsing rules for the default data directory should be consistent across different language bindings.

samples.source: 跨机器复现问题需要同时给出版本、配置与模型清单。
samples.reference: Reproducing an issue across machines needs version, config and a model inventory.
samples.hypothesis: Reproducing the issue across machines requires providing the version, configuration, and model list simultaneously.

samples.source: 安装介质要校验自身完整性再开始复制文件。
samples.reference: Verify installer integrity before copying any file.
samples.hypothesis: The installation medium should verify its own integrity before starting to copy files.

samples.source: 交付时把复现命令一起写进说明，客户才能自己重跑。
samples.reference: Include the reproduction command so a customer can rerun measurements alone.
samples.hypothesis: Include the reproduction command in the instructions during delivery so that the customer can run it themselves.

samples.source: 打包要区分开发构建与发布构建的产物路径。
samples.reference: Separate development and release output paths in packaging.
samples.hypothesis: The packaging should distinguish the output paths for development builds and release builds.

samples.source: 无网络环境下要能只装文档与工具而不装模型。
samples.reference: Allow installing docs and tools without models where there is no network.
samples.hypothesis: In offline environment, the system should be able to install only documents and tools without installing the model.

samples.source: 包内脚本文本模式写入会带平台换行，按字节写更稳。
samples.reference: Write packaged scripts byte-wise; text mode sneaks platform line endings in.
samples.hypothesis: Writing package internal text mode will bring platform line breaks, writing by byte is more stable.

samples.source: 发布构建要能在流水线里复现同一哈希，否则版本不可信。
samples.reference: A release build must be reproducible to the same hash in CI, or a version number means little.
samples.hypothesis: The build release should be able to reproduce the same hash in the pipeline, otherwise the version is not trustworthy.

samples.source: 装机后的首次启动体验要有明确路径，避免用户停在空白界面。
samples.reference: The first launch after install needs a guided path, not an empty window.
samples.hypothesis: The first startup experience after installation should have a clear path to avoid users getting stuck on a blank interface.

samples.source: 安装包的版本号要与运行时自检报出的版本一致。
samples.reference: Keep the installer's version equal to what the runtime self-check reports.
samples.hypothesis: The version number of the installation package should be consistent with the version reported during runtime self-check.

samples.source: 依赖锁定文件要随包发布，便于现场复核。
samples.reference: Ship the lockfile with the package so a site can re-check dependencies.
samples.hypothesis: The dependency lock file should be included with the package for release, facilitating on-site verification.

samples.source: 构建产物目录要与源码目录分离，避免误提交二进制。
samples.reference: Keep build output separate from sources so binaries never get committed.
samples.hypothesis: The build output directory should be separated from the source code directory to avoid accidental submission of binary files.

samples.source: 现场升级前先备份数据目录，失败时能整目录还原。
samples.reference: Back up the data directory before a field upgrade so a failure restores wholesale.
samples.hypothesis: Backup the data directory before on-site upgrade, allowing full directory restoration in case of failure.

samples.source: 打包时剔除测试夹具与开发脚本，减少体积与误用面。
samples.reference: Strip test fixtures and dev scripts from packaging, cutting size and misuse.
samples.hypothesis: Remove test fixtures and development scripts during packaging to reduce size and minimize misuse.

samples.source: 交付文档里的命令要与实际入口一致，避免过期写法。
samples.reference: Keep commands in delivered docs matching real entry points, or they rot.
samples.hypothesis: The commands in the delivery document should be consistent with the actual entry points to avoid outdated writing.

samples.source: 构建脚本失败要非零退出并指明失败阶段。
samples.reference: A failing build step must exit non-zero and name the stage.
samples.hypothesis: Build script failure should exit with a non-zero code and indicate the failed stage.

samples.source: 发布说明要写清哪些行为变化会影响既有指标的对比。
samples.reference: Release notes must state which behaviour changes break comparison with prior metrics.
samples.hypothesis: What behavior changes need to be clearly stated in the release notes that will affect the comparison of existing metrics.

samples.source: 安装介质体积上限由首装网络条件决定，而不是由功能数量决定。
samples.reference: Package size is bounded by first-install network conditions, not by feature count.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum volume of the installation medium is determined by the initial network conditions, not by the number of functions.

samples.source: 现场环境差异要靠诊断接口回读，而不是靠聊天记录推断。
samples.reference: Read field differences back through diagnostics instead of inferring them from chat.
samples.hypothesis: The differences in the on-site environment should be determined through diagnostic interfaces rather than inferred from chat records.

samples.source: 交付物要能在目标机上离线验证哈希一致。
samples.reference: Artefacts must be verifiable offline on the target machine.
samples.hypothesis: The deliverables should be able to verify hash consistency offline on the target machine.

samples.source: 打包链路要能只重建受影响的部分，缩短反馈。
samples.reference: Rebuild only what a change affects, to keep packaging feedback short.
samples.hypothesis: The packaging pipeline should be able to rebuild only the affected parts to shorten the feedback loop.

samples.source: 版本兼容承诺要写明弃用窗口长度，便于客户排期。
samples.reference: State the deprecation window in compatibility promises so customers can plan.
samples.hypothesis: The version compatibility commitment should specify the deprecation window length to facilitate customer scheduling.

samples.source: 发布构建的产物清单要包含每个文件的来源与许可。
samples.reference: A release manifest lists each file's provenance and licence.
samples.hypothesis: The list of built artifacts should include the source and license for each file.

samples.source: 装机脚本要检测缺依赖并给出具体的获取命令。
samples.reference: Detect missing dependencies at install and print the exact fetch command.
samples.hypothesis: The installation script should detect missing dependencies and provide specific commands to obtain them.

samples.source: 现场没有包管理器时，依赖要能整体随包交付。
samples.reference: Ship dependencies whole where a site has no package manager.
samples.hypothesis: When there is no package manager on site, dependencies should be delivered as part of the package overall.

samples.source: 构建与发布分离，避免开发机凭据进入产物。
samples.reference: Separate building from publishing so developer credentials never enter artefacts.
samples.hypothesis: Decouple building from publishing to prevent development machine credentials from entering the output.

samples.source: 可复现构建要固定环境变量与路径归一化规则。
samples.reference: Fix environment variables and path normalization for reproducible builds.
samples.hypothesis: Reproducible builds require fixing environment variables and normalizing path rules.

samples.source: 交付验收要包含一次干净机器安装，避免只在开发机可用。
samples.reference: Include one clean-machine install in acceptance, or it only works on a dev box.
samples.hypothesis: Delivery acceptance should include a clean machine installation, avoiding availability only on the development machine.

samples.source: 包内不要残留绝对路径默认值，否则他人环境不可复现。
samples.reference: Leave no absolute default paths inside a package, or another machine cannot reproduce.
samples.hypothesis: Do not leave absolute path defaults inside the package, otherwise others cannot reproduce the environment.

samples.source: 发布前跑一次全量门禁并把末行结果记进台账。
samples.reference: Run the full gate before release and record its last line in the ledger.
samples.hypothesis: Run a full access control check before release and record the last result in the log.

samples.source: 交付介质要能长期保存，校验和与包同存放。
samples.reference: Store the checksum beside the media so an archive stays verifiable years later.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery medium should be able to be preserved for a long time, and the checksum should be stored with the package.

samples.source: 升级路径要覆盖从最旧交付版本到最新一跳的验证。
samples.reference: Test the upgrade path from the oldest delivered version in one hop.
samples.hypothesis: The upgrade path should cover verification from the oldest delivery version to the latest hop.

samples.source: 现场回滚演练要在交付前做一次，别把第一次留给客户。
samples.reference: Practise the rollback before delivery; the first attempt should not be a customer's.
samples.hypothesis: A rollback exercise should be conducted once before delivery, don't leave the first attempt to the customer.

samples.source: 打包时把第三方素材的许可文本一并装入目录。
samples.reference: Bundle third-party licence texts alongside the packaged material.
samples.hypothesis: Include the license text of third-party materials together in the directory during packaging.

samples.source: 构建环境要固定工具链小版本，避免优化级差异影响性能数字。
samples.reference: Pin toolchain minor versions so optimisation differences do not move performance numbers.
samples.hypothesis: Fix the toolchain minor version to build the environment, avoiding performance discrepancies caused by optimization level differences.

samples.source: 交付包要能单独校验某一个文件的完整性，便于定位损坏。
samples.reference: Allow verifying one file at a time, to localise corruption.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery package should be able to verify the integrity of a single file individually, facilitating the identification of damaged files.

samples.source: 安装后的自检输出要能复制给支持人员，含版本与路径摘要。
samples.reference: Make post-install self-check output copyable to support, with versions and path digests.
samples.hypothesis: The post-installation self-check output should be copyable for support personnel, including a summary of version and path.

samples.source: 无网环境下的文档要随包离线可读。
samples.reference: Ship documentation readable offline for disconnected environments.
samples.hypothesis: Documents in offline environments should be readable with the package.

samples.source: 包内示例语料要确认可公开，避免带入客户素材。
samples.reference: Confirm sample corpora are public-safe, never client material.
samples.hypothesis: The sample corpus inside the package should be confirmed as public, to avoid incorporating customer materials.

samples.source: 发布构建日志要归档，便于事后核对当时环境与结果。
samples.reference: Archive release build logs to reconstruct the environment and outcome later.
samples.hypothesis: Archiving build logs for future reference to verify the environment and results at that time.

samples.source: 交付版本要能回答某个功能在哪个版本引入。
samples.reference: A delivered version must answer which release introduced a feature.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery version should be able to answer which version a certain feature was introduced in.

samples.source: 构建脚本的缓存目录要能指定到盘外，避免污染工作区。
samples.reference: Allow pointing the build cache outside the tree, to keep the working copy clean.
samples.hypothesis: The cache directory for the build script should be able to be specified outside the disk, avoiding pollution of the workspace.

samples.source: 打包前的静态检查要拦住明显的界面与文案错误。
samples.reference: Run static checks before packaging to catch obvious UI and text faults.
samples.hypothesis: Static checks before packaging should catch obvious interface and text errors.

samples.source: 装机脚本要在结束时打印已安装组件与版本一览。
samples.reference: Print the installed components and versions at the end of setup.
samples.hypothesis: The installation script should print a list of installed components and their versions at the end.

samples.source: 现场依赖缺失时，安装器要能指出缺的那一个而不是整体失败。
samples.reference: Report the single missing dependency, rather than failing the whole install.
samples.hypothesis: When dependencies are missing on-site, the installer should be able to identify the missing one rather than failing overall.

samples.source: 交付物的可复现性以他人能跑通为准，而不是本机能跑通。
samples.reference: Reproducibility means someone else can run it, not that this machine can.
samples.hypothesis: The reproducibility of deliverables is based on others being able to run them, not just on this machine being able to run them.

samples.source: 同一张显卡上并行跑推理与合成会互相争用，评测要分阶段进行。
samples.reference: Sharing one GPU between inference and synthesis starves both; measure them in separate phases.
samples.hypothesis: Running inference and synthesis in parallel on the same GPU will compete with each other. The evaluation should be conducted in stages.

samples.source: 显存占用达到临界时系统会开始用内存换页，延迟随之出现长尾。
samples.reference: Near the memory ceiling the system starts paging, and latency grows a long tail.
samples.hypothesis: When VRAM usage reaches the critical level, the system starts swapping memory pages, leading to latency with a long tail.

samples.source: 热降频会让同一模型在连续负载后段变慢，短测看不出这一影响。
samples.reference: Thermal throttling slows the same model late in a sustained load, which a short test will miss.
samples.hypothesis: Thermal throttling will make the same model run slower in the later part of continuous load, but this effect is not noticeable in short tests.

samples.source: 笔记本在电池供电时的功耗墙会改变吞吐，性能数字要注明供电状态。
samples.reference: Battery power caps throughput on laptops, so note the power state next to any number.
samples.hypothesis: The power consumption wall of the notebook when running on battery power will affect throughput. Performance figures should specify the power supply status.

samples.source: 批处理的吞吐提升要除以显存代价来看，否则只是用资源换时间。
samples.reference: Judge batch throughput against the memory it costs, or it is only buying time with resources.
samples.hypothesis: The throughput gain of batch processing should be divided by the VRAM cost, otherwise it's just using resources for time.

samples.source: 磁盘读入模型的时间应计入首装等待，而不是被当成推理耗时。
samples.reference: Loading a model from disk belongs to first-start wait, not to inference time.
samples.hypothesis: The time taken to read the disk into the model should be counted as initial waiting time, rather than being considered as inference time.

samples.source: 同一份权重在不同优化级别下的输出可能不同，回归要固定构建。
samples.reference: The same weights can behave differently across optimisation levels, so pin the build for regressions.
samples.hypothesis: The output of the same weights may vary under different optimization levels; regression requires fixed construction.

samples.source: 采样噪声与真实性能变化靠重复测量区分，单次运行不足以判断。
samples.reference: Repeat a measurement to tell sampling noise from a real change; one run cannot decide.
samples.hypothesis: Sampling noise and true performance variation can be distinguished by repeated measurements, a single run is insufficient to determine.

samples.source: 缓存命中率变化会同时影响延迟与成本，两者要一起看。
samples.reference: A shift in hit rate moves latency and cost together, so read them as a pair.
samples.hypothesis: Changes in cache hit rate affect both latency and cost, and they should be considered together.

samples.source: 慢盘上的并发读写会让队列等待被误读成模型变慢。
samples.reference: On a slow disk, queueing under concurrent IO reads as a slower model.
samples.hypothesis: Concurrent read and write on slow disks can cause the queue to wait, which is misinterpreted as the model slowing down.

samples.source: 性能回归要给出分布而不是均值，长尾正是用户体感所在。
samples.reference: Report a distribution for a regression, not a mean; the tail is where the experience lives.
samples.hypothesis: Performance regression should provide distribution rather than mean, as the long tail is exactly where user experience lies.

samples.source: 量化后的精度损失要用任务指标衡量，而不是只看权重误差。
samples.reference: Judge quantisation loss on task metrics, not on weight error alone.
samples.hypothesis: The precision loss after quantization should be measured by task metrics, rather than just looking at weight error.

samples.source: 多核扩展在队列同步点上会停下来，加速曲线不是线性的。
samples.reference: Multi-core scaling stalls at queue synchronisation points, so the speedup curve is not linear.
samples.hypothesis: Multi-core expansion stops at the queue synchronization point, and the acceleration curve is not linear.

samples.source: 首次请求包含惰性初始化，冷启动时间要单独列出。
samples.reference: The first request carries lazy initialisation, so report cold start separately.
samples.hypothesis: The initial request includes lazy initialization, and the cold start time should be listed separately.

samples.source: 长时间运行后的内存增长要区分缓存驻留与真实泄露。
samples.reference: Distinguish cache residency from a real leak when memory grows over time.
samples.hypothesis: Memory growth after long-running periods should distinguish between cache residency and real leaks.

samples.source: 换页与内存回收会在采样窗口里制造毛刺，需要复采确认。
samples.reference: Paging and garbage collection create spikes, so confirm with a repeat sample.
samples.hypothesis: Page switching and memory recovery will create glitches in the sampling window, requiring resampling confirmation.

samples.source: 同一批任务在不同顺序下耗时不同，基准要固定输入顺序。
samples.reference: The same workload takes different times in different orders, so fix input order in a benchmark.
samples.hypothesis: The same batch of tasks takes different times depending on the order, so the input order should be fixed for the baseline.

samples.source: 性能承诺要绑定运行环境说明，包括芯片、供电与并发规模。
samples.reference: Attach the environment to any performance promise: chip, power state and concurrency.
samples.hypothesis: Performance commitments should be bound to the runtime environment description, including chips, power supply, and concurrency scale.

samples.source: 推理与预处理重叠时，单段耗时会小于两段之和，别误判成加速。
samples.reference: Overlapping inference with pre-processing makes a segment look shorter than the sum, not faster.
samples.hypothesis: When inference overlaps with preprocessing, the time for a single segment will be less than the sum of two segments, do not misjudge it as acceleration.

samples.source: 一个更小的模型在延迟敏感场景可能胜过更大的模型，质量差要看任务。
samples.reference: A smaller model can beat a larger one where latency matters; check the quality cost per task.
samples.hypothesis: A smaller model may outperform a larger model in latency-sensitive scenarios, and the quality difference depends on the task.

samples.source: 缓存预取要按语料重复度决定，随机输入下预取只是额外开销。
samples.reference: Size cache prefetch to corpus repetition; on random input prefetch is pure overhead.
samples.hypothesis: Cache prefetching should be determined by the repetition degree of the corpus. Prefetching under random input is just extra overhead.

samples.source: 并发解码不上调吞吐时，说明瓶颈在算力而不是调度。
samples.reference: If concurrent decoding does not raise throughput, the bottleneck is compute rather than scheduling.
samples.hypothesis: When parallel decoding does not increase throughput, it indicates that the bottleneck is in computing power rather than scheduling.

samples.source: 负载上升时先退化的是尾延迟而不是中位数，指标要成对看。
samples.reference: Under rising load the tail degrades before the median, so read the pair together.
samples.hypothesis: When the load increases, the tail latency degrades before the median, and the metrics should be viewed in pairs.

samples.source: 把等待时间与处理时间混在一个指标里会掩盖排队积压。
samples.reference: Mixing waiting and processing into one metric hides queue build-up.
samples.hypothesis: Combining waiting time and processing time into a single metric can obscure queue buildup.

samples.source: 评测用的机器要与交付目标同档，否则数字没有参考价值。
samples.reference: Benchmark on hardware in the delivered class, or the numbers mean nothing.
samples.hypothesis: The test machines should be at the same level as the delivery targets; otherwise, the numbers have no reference value.

samples.source: 内存上限保护比更大的缓存更能保证长时间运行不崩。
samples.reference: A memory ceiling protects a long run better than a larger cache does.
samples.hypothesis: Memory upper limit protection ensures longer runtime stability better than a larger cache.

samples.source: 多线程解码会增加上下文切换，小文本上反而更慢。
samples.reference: Threaded decoding adds context switches and is slower on short text.
samples.hypothesis: Multithreaded decoding increases context switching, and is actually slower for small texts.

samples.source: 硬件加速的收益在算子覆盖不全时会打折，需要实测。
samples.reference: Acceleration pays off only as far as operators are covered, so measure it.
samples.hypothesis: The benefits of hardware acceleration will be reduced when the operator coverage is incomplete, and actual measurement is needed.

samples.source: 性能基线要记录采集时间，跨日对比要留意后台任务干扰。
samples.reference: Stamp performance baselines with collection time; background jobs disturb day-to-day comparison.
samples.hypothesis: Performance baseline should record the collection time, and pay attention to background task interference when comparing across days.

samples.source: 一个未接上的加速开关不该被写成功能收益。
samples.reference: An acceleration switch that is not wired up must not be reported as a gain.
samples.hypothesis: An unconnected acceleration switch should not be written as a functional gain.

samples.source: 长文本按段送入会让总耗时上升，但峰值内存会明显下降。
samples.reference: Feeding long text segment by segment raises total time but lowers peak memory.
samples.hypothesis: Processing long text in segments increases the total time but significantly reduces peak memory usage.

samples.source: 同一模型的量化版与全精度版要分开报指标。
samples.reference: Report quantised and full-precision variants of one model as separate rows.
samples.hypothesis: The quantized version and the full-precision version of the same model should report metrics separately.

samples.source: 评测环境里常驻服务会占用显存，测量前要先声明。
samples.reference: Note resident services holding memory before measuring; they change the result.
samples.hypothesis: Persistent services in the evaluation environment consume VRAM. You need to declare them before measurement.

samples.source: 性能改善要与质量指标同批检查，避免只快不差的说法站不住。
samples.reference: Check performance and quality together, so "faster and equal" is defensible.
samples.hypothesis: Performance improvements should be checked together with quality indicators to avoid the statement that "faster but not better" being invalid.

samples.source: 队列积压告警要基于等待时间而不是队列长度。
samples.reference: Alert on queue age rather than queue depth, since depth alone is not user-visible harm.
samples.hypothesis: Queue backlog alerts should be based on waiting time rather than queue length.

samples.source: 一个批次的总耗时不能简单除以条数当单次延迟。
samples.reference: Do not divide a batch's total by its count and call it single-request latency.
samples.hypothesis: The total latency of a batch cannot simply be divided by the number of items when considering single latency.

samples.source: 首次装载与后续命中的延迟差要同时给出，避免只报好看的一档。
samples.reference: Give both cold-load and warm latency; reporting one flatters the number.
samples.hypothesis: The latency difference between the first load and subsequent cache hits should be provided together, avoiding only reporting the better-looking one.

samples.source: 设备驱动更新会改变算子实现，性能结论要注明驱动版本。
samples.reference: Driver updates change kernel behaviour, so record the driver version with a result.
samples.hypothesis: Device driver updates change the operator implementation. Performance conclusions should note the driver version.

samples.source: 并发上限的设定要以资源实测为据，而不是按核数猜测。
samples.reference: Set concurrency ceilings from measured resources, not from a core count.
samples.hypothesis: The setting of concurrency limits should be based on actual resource measurements, not on guessing based on core counts.

samples.source: 性能报表里区分吞吐与延迟两个目标，二者常相互拉扯。
samples.reference: Keep throughput and latency as two goals in reports; they pull apart.
samples.hypothesis: The performance report distinguishes between throughput and latency, which often conflict with each other.

samples.source: 长任务的进度回报要能反映实际完成量，而不是固定节奏。
samples.reference: Progress for long jobs should reflect completed work, not a fixed tick.
samples.hypothesis: The progress report for long-term tasks should reflect the actual amount completed, rather than a fixed pace.

samples.source: 一个指标的改善要能归因到具体变更，否则只是波动。
samples.reference: Attribute a metric's improvement to a specific change, or it is just noise.
samples.hypothesis: An improvement in a metric should be attributable to a specific change; otherwise, it is just fluctuation.

samples.source: 评测脚本自身的日志写入也会拖慢被测服务。
samples.reference: Log writing by the harness itself can slow the service under test.
samples.hypothesis: The log writing of the evaluation script itself can also slow down the service under test.

samples.source: 性能回归要设置可判定的阈值并允许噪声带。
samples.reference: Give a regression a decided threshold with a noise band around it.
samples.hypothesis: Performance regression should set a discriminable threshold and allow for a noise band.

samples.source: 无加速硬件的机器也要能跑通，功能不应依赖特定算子。
samples.reference: Features must run on machines without accelerators, not on a specific kernel.
samples.hypothesis: Machines without acceleration hardware should also be able to run, and functionality should not depend on specific operators.

samples.source: 一个缓存的收益要按命中率与失效成本共同评估。
samples.reference: Judge a cache by hit rate and invalidation cost together.
samples.hypothesis: The benefit of a cache should be evaluated together with hit rate and cache miss cost.

samples.source: 短任务被启动开销主导时，优化算法本身收效有限。
samples.reference: When start-up cost dominates short tasks, optimising the algorithm returns little.
samples.hypothesis: When short tasks are dominated by startup overhead, optimizing the algorithm itself yields limited benefits.

samples.source: 并发数从一到二的收益常小于从二到三，注意边际递减。
samples.reference: The gain from one to two concurrent workers is usually smaller than from two to three.
samples.hypothesis: The gain from increasing concurrency from 1 to 2 is often less than from 2 to 3, noting the diminishing marginal returns.

samples.source: 一个性能数字若不能重跑，就只能作为历史事实引用。
samples.reference: Cite an unreproducible performance number only as a historical fact.
samples.hypothesis: A performance figure that cannot be rerun can only be cited as historical fact.

samples.source: 测量前确认没有其他负载在同一设备上运行。
samples.reference: Confirm nothing else is running on the device before measuring.
samples.hypothesis: Make sure there are no other loads operating on the same device before measurement.

samples.source: 内存换页会让尾延迟出现分钟级尖峰，别当成模型退化。
samples.reference: Paging produces minute-scale spikes in tail latency; do not call it model decay.
samples.hypothesis: Memory paging can cause latency spikes of minutes, don't consider it as model degradation.

samples.source: 一个硬件相关开关未接通时，界面上的选项要如实标注。
samples.reference: Label a hardware switch honestly when it is not actually wired up.
samples.hypothesis: When a hardware-related switch is not turned on, the options on the interface should be accurately labeled.

samples.source: 性能测量要区分单次成本与摊销成本。
samples.reference: Separate per-item cost from amortised cost in performance measurement.
samples.hypothesis: Performance measurement should distinguish between one-time costs and amortized costs.

samples.source: 一个优化的收益若被额外等待吃掉，净效果为零。
samples.reference: An optimisation whose gain is eaten by extra waiting nets out to zero.
samples.hypothesis: An optimized gain, if consumed by waiting additionally, results in a net effect of zero.

samples.source: 长时间运行的稳定性用退出码与错误计数衡量。
samples.reference: Measure long-run stability by exit codes and error counts, not by optimism.
samples.hypothesis: Stability over long operation is measured by exit codes and error counts.

samples.source: 一个报告的结论要能指向同一台机器上的可复现数据。
samples.reference: A report's conclusion should point to data reproducible on the same machine.
samples.hypothesis: The conclusion of a report should be able to point to reproducible data on the same machine.

samples.source: 性能与质量的取舍要写成产品决策而不是技术默认值。
samples.reference: Record performance-versus-quality choices as product decisions, not technical defaults.
samples.hypothesis: Trade-offs between performance and quality should be written as product decisions rather than technical defaults.

samples.source: 模型推理的能耗在长时间批量任务里也会成为约束。
samples.reference: Energy becomes a constraint in long batch inference, not only in mobile use.
samples.hypothesis: The energy consumption of model inference can also become a constraint in long-term batch tasks.

samples.source: 一个未固定的构建会让两次测量结果不可比。
samples.reference: An unpinned build makes two measurements incomparable.
samples.hypothesis: An unfixed build makes the two measurement results incomparable.

samples.source: 把设备差异写进结论限定，比在正文里加免责声明有效。
samples.reference: Stating device scope inside a conclusion beats a disclaimer elsewhere.
samples.hypothesis: Including device differences in the conclusion limitations is more effective than adding a disclaimer in the main text.

samples.source: 测量窗口要避开系统更新与索引重建的时间段。
samples.reference: Schedule measurement windows away from system updates and index rebuilds.
samples.hypothesis: The measurement window should avoid the period of system updates and index rebuilding.

samples.source: 一个加速路径的正确性要单独测，别只测它有多快。
samples.reference: Test an accelerated path for correctness separately from its speed.
samples.hypothesis: The correctness of an accelerated path should be tested separately, not just how fast it is.

samples.source: 性能相关的缺陷要给出可复跑入口，便于回归验证。
samples.reference: A performance defect needs a re-runnable entry point for regression checks.
samples.hypothesis: Defects related to performance should provide reproducible entry points to facilitate regression verification.

samples.source: 批量吞吐提升不等于单条延迟改善，两者分别验收。
samples.reference: Higher batch throughput is not lower per-item latency; accept them separately.
samples.hypothesis: Batch throughput improvement is not equal to single-line latency improvement; they are verified separately.

samples.source: 一个指标的抖动若大于版本差异，就不足以支撑结论。
samples.reference: When a metric's jitter exceeds the version difference, it cannot support a conclusion.
samples.hypothesis: If the jitter of an indicator is greater than the version difference, it is insufficient to support the conclusion.

samples.source: 飞轮的前提是AI先做对一次，之后本地复用才省成本。
samples.reference: The flywheel assumes the AI got it right once, so local reuse is what saves afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The premise of a flywheel is that AI must first do things correctly once, and then local reuse can save costs.

samples.source: 蒸馏入库的阈值决定术语表信噪比，过松会污染后续所有请求。
samples.reference: The distillation threshold sets the glossary's signal-to-noise ratio; too loose pollutes every later request.
samples.hypothesis: The threshold for distillation entry determines the signal-to-noise ratio in the glossary. If it is too lenient, it will contaminate all subsequent requests.

samples.source: 机器抽取的条目要能与人工确认的条目区分，复核才有效。
samples.reference: Machine-extracted rows must be distinguishable from human-confirmed ones, or review is pointless.
samples.hypothesis: The entries extracted by machine should be distinguishable from those confirmed by humans, so that the verification process is effective.

samples.source: 同一术语在不同领域下允许不同译法，主键必须含领域。
samples.reference: One term may translate differently per domain, so the key must include the domain.
samples.hypothesis: The same term may have different translations in different domains, and the primary key must include the domain.

samples.source: 用户修改过的条目应优先于任何自动来源，且不被静默覆盖。
samples.reference: A user's edit outranks any automatic source and must not be silently overwritten.
samples.hypothesis: Entries modified by users should take precedence over any automatic sources and should not be silently overwritten.

samples.source: 术语表要能导出复核，且导出不带用户私有条目。
samples.reference: A glossary must be exportable for review, without the user's private rows.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary should be able to export for review, and the export should not include user private entries.

samples.source: 蒸馏产出的碎片化条目要靠源侧语言校验拦住。
samples.reference: Fragmented distillation output has to be stopped by a source-language check.
samples.hypothesis: The fragmented entries produced by distillation need to be blocked by source-side language validation.

samples.source: 飞轮收益要靠命中率与质量同时验证，只看其一会误判。
samples.reference: Validate the flywheel with both hit rate and quality; either alone misleads.
samples.hypothesis: Flywheel benefits need to be verified by both hit rate and quality; only looking at one aspect can lead to misjudgment.

samples.source: 一次误译被记忆固化后会被反复复用，标坏机制要可用。
samples.reference: A mistranslation stored in memory is reused forever, so the bad-mark path must work.
samples.hypothesis: Once a mistranslation is solidified in memory, it will be reused repeatedly, and the bad mechanism must be available.

samples.source: 术语表的规模不等于注入规模，能进上下文的那部分才是效果。
samples.reference: Glossary size is not injection size; only the rows reaching context have effect.
samples.hypothesis: The scale of the glossary does not equal the injection scale; only the part that fits into the context has an effect.

samples.source: 注入窗口按置信度排序时，平局必须有确定序，否则不可复现。
samples.reference: When the injection window sorts by confidence, ties need a deterministic order, or runs are irreproducible.
samples.hypothesis: When injecting windows are sorted by confidence, ties must have a determined order, otherwise the results cannot be reproducible.

samples.source: 一条术语是否生效，要靠响应字段回读而不是靠猜测。
samples.reference: Read back whether a term applied from the response, do not guess it.
samples.hypothesis: Whether a term takes effect depends on reading the response field rather than guessing.

samples.source: 蒸馏回灌的条目要能整体关闭，便于隔离问题。
samples.reference: Returned distillation rows must be switchable off wholesale, to isolate faults.
samples.hypothesis: The entry for distillation backflow should be able to be completely closed, facilitating isolation of the issue.

samples.source: 术语表变更要能被评测复跑反映，否则改了语义却看不见。
samples.reference: Glossary changes must surface in a re-run, or a semantic change stays invisible.
samples.hypothesis: Changes to the glossary should be reflected in the evaluation reruns, otherwise the semantic changes would not be visible.

samples.source: 一条错误术语的代价是它会被每个含该词的句子复用。
samples.reference: The cost of one wrong term is that every sentence containing it reuses it.
samples.hypothesis: The cost of a wrong term is that it will be reused in every sentence containing the word.

samples.source: 术语治理的核心是可追溯：来源、置信度与修改人要能区分。
samples.reference: Glossary governance is traceability: source, confidence and editor must be distinguishable.
samples.hypothesis: The core of terminology governance is traceability: the source, confidence, and modifier should be distinguishable.

samples.source: 锁定与删除是两种不同保护，不能相互替代。
samples.reference: Locking and deleting are different protections and cannot substitute for each other.
samples.hypothesis: Locking and deletion are two different protections and cannot replace each other.

samples.source: 按语言对分别维护术语表，跨语言对复用会串味。
samples.reference: Maintain glossaries per language pair; reusing across pairs bleeds meaning.
samples.hypothesis: Maintain glossaries separately by language pairs, and reuse across language pairs may cause inconsistency.

samples.source: 新领域包的收益要用同批句子对照测，不做跨批比较。
samples.reference: Test a new domain pack on the same sentences, never across batches.
samples.hypothesis: The gains of the new domain package should be tested using sentences from the same batch as a reference, and no cross-batch comparisons should be made.

samples.source: 人工复核过的条目要能标注来源批次，便于回退。
samples.reference: Reviewed rows should record which batch they came from, to allow reversal.
samples.hypothesis: Entries that have been manually reviewed should be able to mark the source batch, facilitating rollback.

samples.source: 术语冲突要报出双方来源，而不是静默选一个。
samples.reference: Term conflicts must name both provenances rather than silently picking one.
samples.hypothesis: Term conflicts should report both sources instead of silently choosing one.

samples.source: 蒸馏阈值调整后要重跑质量回归，否则信噪比未知。
samples.reference: Rerun the quality regression after changing the distillation threshold, or the ratio is unknown.
samples.hypothesis: After adjusting the distillation threshold, re-run the quality regression, otherwise the signal-to-noise ratio is unknown.

samples.source: 一条术语的译文若含变量占位，需要显式转义规则。
samples.reference: Escape rules are needed when a term's translation contains a placeholder.
samples.hypothesis: If a translation of a term contains variable placeholders, explicit escaping rules are needed.

samples.source: 飞轮的收益上限由重复内容占比决定，不由模型决定。
samples.reference: The flywheel's ceiling is set by how repetitive the content is, not by the model.
samples.hypothesis: The upper limit of the flywheel's benefits is determined by the proportion of duplicate content, not by the model.

samples.source: 术语表要能按领域整体替换，便于客户自带词表交付。
samples.reference: Allow replacing a whole domain glossary so a customer's own terms can ship.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary should be able to replace the vocabulary by domain as a whole, facilitating customer's delivery of their own vocabulary.

samples.source: 一次注入失败要区分引擎不支持与本次无命中。
samples.reference: Separate "engine cannot use terms" from "no term matched this sentence".
samples.hypothesis: A failed injection should distinguish between engine unsupported and no cache hit this time.

samples.source: 统计口径要说清分母是全部行还是含术语的行。
samples.reference: State whether a denominator is all rows or only rows containing terms.
samples.hypothesis: The denominator should clarify whether it refers to all lines or lines containing terminology.

samples.source: 术语表与记忆库的更新要能分别回滚。
samples.reference: Roll back the glossary and the memory store independently.
samples.hypothesis: The updates to the glossary and memory database should be able to roll back separately.

samples.source: 蒸馏的批处理窗口影响入库顺序，跨批比较需谨慎。
samples.reference: A distillation batch window affects insert order, so cross-batch comparison needs care.
samples.hypothesis: The batch processing window of distillation affects the入库 order, and cross-batch comparisons should be handled with caution.

samples.source: 一条被锁定的术语仍可被本人再次修改，锁不是权限墙。
samples.reference: A locked row stays editable by its own author; a lock is not a permission wall.
samples.hypothesis: A locked term can still be modified by the owner again. The lock is not a permission wall.

samples.source: 术语治理的效果最终体现在一致性指标，而不是条目数量。
samples.reference: Governance shows up in consistency metrics, not in row counts.
samples.hypothesis: The effectiveness of terminology governance is ultimately reflected in consistency metrics, not the number of entries.

samples.source: 一个领域包的覆盖率要按语料实测，不靠条目数推断。
samples.reference: Measure a pack's coverage against the corpus, do not infer it from row counts.
samples.hypothesis: The coverage of a domain package should be measured based on actual corpus testing, not inferred from the number of entries.

samples.source: 新词冷启动阶段，人工先补几条高价值术语比批量灌入更有效。
samples.reference: At cold start, a few hand-picked high-value terms beat bulk import.
samples.hypothesis: In the new term cold start phase, manually adding a few high-value terms is more effective than bulk importing.

samples.source: 同一术语的两种译法并存时，要显式选择并记录原因。
samples.reference: Where two renderings coexist, choose explicitly and record why.
samples.hypothesis: When two translation methods for the same term coexist, explicit selection and recording of the reason are required.

samples.source: 飞轮假设的是正确译法被复用，错误复用会放大问题。
samples.reference: The flywheel assumes correct renderings get reused; reusing wrong ones amplifies them.
samples.hypothesis: The flywheel assumes that correct translations are reused; incorrect reuse will amplify the problem.

samples.source: 一个术语包的许可与来源要可追溯，禁止传染性许可进入。
samples.reference: Keep a pack's licence and provenance traceable, and exclude copyleft sources.
samples.hypothesis: The license and source of a terminology package should be traceable, and infectious licenses should be prohibited.

samples.source: 术语表条目要能按来源批量清理，便于回退一次误灌。
samples.reference: Allow bulk cleanup by provenance, to undo one bad import.
samples.hypothesis: Glossary entries should be able to be cleaned in batches by source for easy rollback of accidental data灌注.

samples.source: 一次导入部分失败必须整体拒绝，不留半套条目。
samples.reference: Refuse a partially failed import whole, leaving no half-applied rows.
samples.hypothesis: A partial import failure must reject the entire import, leaving no partial entries.

samples.source: 一条术语的置信度不由导入路径抬高，声明值就是最终值。
samples.reference: Do not raise a declared confidence during import; the authored value is final.
samples.hypothesis: The confidence of a term is not raised by the import path; the declared value is the final value.

samples.source: 删除领域行需要按完整主键操作，否则碰到同名通用行。
samples.reference: Deleting a domain row needs the full key, or it hits a generic twin instead.
samples.hypothesis: Deleting a domain line requires operating on the complete primary key, otherwise it may encounter a general line with the same name.

samples.source: 术语治理的评审节奏要与语料扩充同步，否则指标漂移。
samples.reference: Keep glossary review in step with corpus growth, or metrics drift.
samples.hypothesis: The review rhythm of terminology governance should be synchronized with corpus expansion, otherwise the metrics will drift.

samples.source: 一条被禁用的术语要能保留历史而不参与注入。
samples.reference: Keep a retired term for history while excluding it from injection.
samples.hypothesis: A disabled term should retain its history without participating in injection.

samples.source: 术语表要按客户环境分级：通用、领域、项目三层。
samples.reference: Layer glossaries by scope: generic, domain and project.
samples.hypothesis: The glossary should be categorized by customer environment into three levels: general, domain, and project.

samples.source: 一个词的多义性要靠上下文消歧，而不是靠强制唯一。
samples.reference: Handle polysemy with context, not by forcing one rendering.
samples.hypothesis: Polysemy of a single word relies on context to resolve ambiguity, rather than forced uniqueness.

samples.source: 飞轮的度量要包含升级率，升级频繁说明本地能力不足。
samples.reference: Include the upgrade rate in flywheel metrics; frequent upgrades mean local capability is thin.
samples.hypothesis: The measurement of a flywheel should include the upgrade rate; frequent upgrades indicate insufficient local capabilities.

samples.source: 一次测量若只跑单臂，就没有可比的对照组。
samples.reference: A single-arm measurement has nothing to compare against.
samples.hypothesis: A single-arm measurement lacks a comparable control group.

samples.source: 术语注入与记忆复用是两条通路，效果要分别归因。
samples.reference: Injection and memory reuse are two paths; attribute their effects separately.
samples.hypothesis: Term injection and memory reuse are two pathways, and their effects should be attributed separately.

samples.source: 一个领域包的评审记录要能指向具体条目变更。
samples.reference: Pack review must point to specific row changes.
samples.hypothesis: The review record of a domain package should be able to point to specific item changes.

samples.source: 术语冲突处理要保守，宁可报出歧义也不静默改写。
samples.reference: Handle term conflicts conservatively: report ambiguity instead of rewriting silently.
samples.hypothesis: Handle term conflicts conservatively, prefer reporting ambiguity over silent rewriting.

samples.source: 一条自动条目的默认置信度要低于人工确认的值。
samples.reference: Automatic rows need a lower default confidence than human-confirmed ones.
samples.hypothesis: The default confidence of an automatic entry is lower than that of a manually confirmed value.

samples.source: 术语表的变更要与评测身份一起记录，便于事后解释数字。
samples.reference: Record glossary changes with the measurement identity, to explain numbers later.
samples.hypothesis: Changes to the glossary should be recorded together with the evaluation identity for easy explanation of the numbers later.

samples.source: 一次导入的成功与否要按写入数而非条目数判断。
samples.reference: Judge an import by rows written, not rows supplied.
samples.hypothesis: The success of an import should be determined by the number of writes rather than the number of entries.

samples.source: 一个包的收益若测不出，先检查注入是否真到达。
samples.reference: If a pack shows no gain, check first whether injection actually arrived.
samples.hypothesis: If the gain of a package cannot be measured, first check whether the injection has truly arrived.

samples.source: 术语治理的产出是可复用的领域资产，不是一次性配置。
samples.reference: Glossary governance yields a reusable domain asset, not one-off configuration.
samples.hypothesis: The output of terminology governance is reusable domain assets, not one-time configurations.

samples.source: 飞轮的每一环都要有可观测点，否则退化无法定位。
samples.reference: Every link of the flywheel needs an observable, or decay cannot be located.
samples.hypothesis: Each ring of the flywheel must have observable points; otherwise, degradation cannot be localized.

samples.source: 一次锁定的解除要能追溯到谁操作。
samples.reference: Unlocking a row must be traceable to an actor.
samples.hypothesis: The removal of a lock should be traceable to who operated it.

samples.source: 一条术语的译文长度会影响排版与停留时长。
samples.reference: A term's translation length affects layout and dwell time.
samples.hypothesis: The length of a term's translation affects layout and dwell time.

samples.source: 术语表的变更要能只回滚本次导入的批次。
samples.reference: Roll back exactly the batch a change introduced.
samples.hypothesis: The changes to the glossary should be able to roll back only the current import batch.

samples.source: 一次评测的术语集要与交付时一致，否则结论不适用。
samples.reference: Keep the evaluation term set equal to the delivered one, or the conclusion does not apply.
samples.hypothesis: The terminology set for a single evaluation should be consistent with delivery, otherwise the conclusion is not applicable.

samples.source: 一个领域包的可维护性体现在条目粒度均匀。
samples.reference: A pack stays maintainable when row granularity is even.
samples.hypothesis: Maintainability of a domain package is reflected in the uniformity of entry granularity.

samples.source: 术语治理要避免堆积无证据的条目，定期回收低命中的行。
samples.reference: Avoid accumulating unevidenced rows; retire low-hit ones periodically.
samples.hypothesis: Term governance should avoid accumulating entries without evidence and regularly recycle rows with low cache hit.

samples.source: 一次误译被采纳后会通过飞轮放大，评审门槛要前移。
samples.reference: An accepted mistranslation is amplified by the flywheel, so gate it earlier.
samples.hypothesis: Once a mistranslation is adopted, it will be amplified by the flywheel effect, and the review threshold needs to be moved forward.

samples.source: 术语表的最终价值由客户可感一致性决定。
samples.reference: The worth of a glossary is the consistency a customer can perceive.
samples.hypothesis: The ultimate value of a glossary is determined by the customer's perceptible consistency.

samples.source: 引擎标签要显示实际作答者，用户才能判断结果来自哪一档。
samples.reference: Show which engine actually answered, so users can tell which tier produced the result.
samples.hypothesis: The engine label should show the actual answerer so that users can determine which level the result comes from.

samples.source: 降级提示要用平实语言说明原因与下一步，不只显示错误码。
samples.reference: State the reason and the next step in plain words, not only an error code.
samples.hypothesis: The downgrade prompt should use plain language to explain the reason and next steps, not just display an error code.

samples.source: 长文本结果的复制按钮要在收起面板前保持可见。
samples.reference: Keep the copy button reachable before a panel collapses.
samples.hypothesis: The copy button for long text results should remain visible before the collapsed panel.

samples.source: 所有状态变化都要有文本形式，不能只靠颜色区分。
samples.reference: Every status change needs a text form, not colour alone.
samples.hypothesis: All state changes must be indicated in text form and cannot rely solely on color differentiation.

samples.source: 表格列宽要允许用户调整并记忆，术语表列数会随版本增加。
samples.reference: Let users resize and keep column widths, as the glossary gains columns over versions.
samples.hypothesis: The column width of the table should allow users to adjust and remember it, and the number of columns in the glossary will increase with each version.

samples.source: 键盘焦点在翻译后要留在输入区，便于连续操作。
samples.reference: Keep keyboard focus in the input area after a translation, for continuous work.
samples.hypothesis: The keyboard focus should remain in the input area after translation to facilitate continuous operations.

samples.source: 进度条要能取消，取消后明确说明底层调用仍在收尾。
samples.reference: A progress bar must be cancellable, and say the native call still drains afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The progress bar should be cancelable, and after cancellation, it should clearly indicate that the underlying call is still in the process of finishing.

samples.source: 错误提示要避免术语缩写，把内部名词翻译成人话。
samples.reference: Write errors without internal jargon; translate internal names into plain language.
samples.hypothesis: Error messages should avoid technical jargon and translate internal nouns into everyday language.

samples.source: 界面文案要与帮助文档同一措辞，避免同一功能两个名字。
samples.reference: Use the same wording across UI and help, or one feature gets two names.
samples.hypothesis: The interface text should use the same wording as the help documentation to avoid having two different names for the same function.

samples.source: 读屏软件需要每个状态行都有明确标签与角色。
samples.reference: Screen readers need an explicit label and role on every status line.
samples.hypothesis: Screen reading software requires each status line to have clear labels and roles.

samples.source: 默认焦点不要落在会触发联网的按钮上。
samples.reference: Do not put default focus on a button that triggers a network call.
samples.hypothesis: The default focus should not be on the button that triggers network connection.

samples.source: 批量任务的完成提示要给出成功与失败条数两项。
samples.reference: A batch completion notice must give both succeeded and failed counts.
samples.hypothesis: The completion prompt for batch tasks should include both the number of successful and failed items.

samples.source: 表格排序要稳定，同值行的顺序不能每次刷新都变。
samples.reference: Keep table sorting stable; equal-valued rows must not reshuffle on refresh.
samples.hypothesis: The table sorting should be stable, and the order of rows with the same value should not change every time the page is refreshed.

samples.source: 禁用项要有原因提示，灰掉而不说明会被当成故障。
samples.reference: Explain a disabled control, or a greyed-out one reads as a defect.
samples.hypothesis: Disabled items should have reasons indicated. Being grayed out without explanation will be considered as a malfunction.

samples.source: 首次启动的缺模型提示要包含可复制的获取命令。
samples.reference: The first-launch missing-model notice should carry a copyable fetch command.
samples.hypothesis: The initial missing model prompt should include copyable acquisition commands.

samples.source: 界面要能只显示用户确认过的条目，便于核对来源。
samples.reference: Let the UI show only user-confirmed rows, to make provenance checkable.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should display only the items confirmed by the user to facilitate source verification.

samples.source: 长列表的滚动位置在切换语言对后要重置。
samples.reference: Reset scroll position when switching language pairs in a long list.
samples.hypothesis: The scroll position of a long list should be reset after switching language pairs.

samples.source: 输入框的粘贴内容要显式声明长度上限与超限行为。
samples.reference: State the paste length limit and what happens beyond it.
samples.hypothesis: The pasted content in the input box should explicitly declare the length limit and the behavior when exceeded.

samples.source: 提示文案里的数字要与实际配置值同源，不写死。
samples.reference: Pull numbers in messages from live config, never hardcode them.
samples.hypothesis: The numbers in the prompt text should be sourced from the actual configuration values and not hard-coded.

samples.source: 取消操作不能造成已完成的成果丢失，只丢弃在飞结果。
samples.reference: Cancelling must not lose finished work, only what was still in flight.
samples.hypothesis: Canceling the operation should not cause the loss of completed results, only discarding the intermediate results.

samples.source: 表格的单元格换行要保留，长术语不能截断显示。
samples.reference: Wrap cell text so long terms stay fully visible.
samples.hypothesis: Line breaks in table cells should be preserved, and long terms should not be truncated.

samples.source: 状态栏的临时消息要被新的操作打断而不是堆积。
samples.reference: A transient status message should be replaced, not queued behind others.
samples.hypothesis: Temporary messages in the status bar should be interrupted by new actions rather than piling up.

samples.source: 对话框里的危险操作要写清影响范围与是否可恢复。
samples.reference: Spell out blast radius and reversibility in a destructive dialog.
samples.hypothesis: Dangerous operations in the dialog box should clearly state the scope of impact and whether they are reversible.

samples.source: 界面在等待外部服务时不得显示为无响应。
samples.reference: The interface must stay responsive while waiting on an external service.
samples.hypothesis: The interface must not appear unresponsive while waiting for external services.

samples.source: 可访问性检查要包含对比度与焦点顺序两项。
samples.reference: Include contrast and focus order in accessibility checks.
samples.hypothesis: Accessibility check should include contrast and focus order.

samples.source: 一个指标的展示精度要与测量精度一致。
samples.reference: Show a metric to its measurement precision, no further.
samples.hypothesis: The display accuracy of an indicator should be consistent with the measurement accuracy.

samples.source: 错误提示要能复制出完整上下文，供支持人员定位。
samples.reference: Let users copy the full context of an error for support.
samples.hypothesis: Error messages should include the complete context to help support personnel locate the issue.

samples.source: 表格要能按来源列筛选，机器条目与人工条目分开看。
samples.reference: Filter the table by source, to view machine and human rows apart.
samples.hypothesis: The table should be able to filter by the source column, allowing machine entries and human entries to be viewed separately.

samples.source: 空状态要有下一步指引，不留白屏。
samples.reference: An empty state needs a next step, never a blank pane.
samples.hypothesis: Empty state should have next steps guidance, no blank screen.

samples.source: 按钮的文案要说明结果而不是过程。
samples.reference: Button labels should name the outcome, not the mechanism.
samples.hypothesis: The button text should explain the result rather than the process.

samples.source: 界面语言与内容语言要能分别显示，不相互覆盖。
samples.reference: Keep interface language and content language distinct.
samples.hypothesis: The interface language and content language should be able to display separately without overlapping each other.

samples.source: 高级设置项要说明生效时机，是重启还是即时。
samples.reference: Advanced settings must say when they apply: immediately or after restart.
samples.hypothesis: Advanced settings should specify the timing of effect, such as reboot or immediate.

samples.source: 一次操作的反馈要与操作在同一区域，避免视线跳跃。
samples.reference: Keep feedback beside the control that produced it.
samples.hypothesis: Feedback for an operation should be in the same area as the operation to avoid visual jumping.

samples.source: 列表的排序依据要在表头显式标注。
samples.reference: Mark the active sort column in the header.
samples.hypothesis: The sorting criteria for the list should be explicitly labeled in the table header.

samples.source: 删除确认要显示将被删除的条目数量。
samples.reference: A delete confirmation must show how many rows are involved.
samples.hypothesis: Delete confirmation shows the number of items to be deleted.

samples.source: 不可用的功能要在界面上说明缺哪个前置条件。
samples.reference: Name the missing precondition for an unavailable feature.
samples.hypothesis: Unavailable functions should indicate which prerequisite conditions are missing on the interface.

samples.source: 输入过长时给出分段建议，而不是静默截断。
samples.reference: Suggest splitting on over-long input, rather than truncating quietly.
samples.hypothesis: Provide segmentation suggestions when input is too long, instead of silently truncating.

samples.source: 界面要能显示当前生效的路径而不是配置意图。
samples.reference: Show the routing that is actually in force, not what configuration intended.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should display the currently effective path instead of the configuration intent.

samples.source: 提示语要避免把技术选择说成用户错误。
samples.reference: Avoid framing a technical limitation as the user's mistake.
samples.hypothesis: Warnings should avoid blaming users for technical choices.

samples.source: 批量导入结果要区分写入数与给出数。
samples.reference: Import results must separate rows written from rows supplied.
samples.hypothesis: The import results should distinguish between the number written and the number provided.

samples.source: 状态文案里的引擎名要与其注册标识一致。
samples.reference: Keep engine names equal to their registered identifiers.
samples.hypothesis: The engine name in the status text should be consistent with its registered identifier.

samples.source: 列表刷新要保留当前选择，除非该条目已消失。
samples.reference: Preserve the current selection across refreshes unless it no longer exists.
samples.hypothesis: List refresh should retain the current selection unless the item has disappeared.

samples.source: 界面文案的变更要与文档同一提交，避免两处不同版本。
samples.reference: Change UI text and docs in one commit, or they diverge.
samples.hypothesis: Changes to interface copy should be submitted together with the documentation to avoid having different versions in two places.

samples.source: 键盘快捷键要避开输入法占用组合。
samples.reference: Pick shortcuts that do not collide with input-method bindings.
samples.hypothesis: Keyboard shortcuts should avoid combinations occupied by input methods.

samples.source: 提示中引用路径要能复制，且不含个人目录。
samples.reference: Copyable paths in messages, without a personal directory inside.
samples.hypothesis: The referenced path in the prompt should be copyable and not contain personal directories.

samples.source: 进度百分比在无法计量时改为显示已完成条数。
samples.reference: Show a completed count instead of a percentage that cannot be measured.
samples.hypothesis: Change the percentage progress to display the number of completed items when it is not measurable.

samples.source: 同一状态在界面、日志与诊断接口要同名。
samples.reference: Keep one name for a state across UI, logs and diagnostics.
samples.hypothesis: The same status should have the same name in the interface, logs, and diagnostic interface.

samples.source: 界面要在长时间等待时说明是否仍在处理。
samples.reference: Reassure the user that work continues during a long wait.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should indicate whether processing is still ongoing during long waits.

samples.source: 一个开关的标签要说它控制的对象而不是效果。
samples.reference: Label a switch by what it controls, not by a hoped-for effect.
samples.hypothesis: A switch label should state what it controls rather than the effect.

samples.source: 表格要能显示条目的来源标记列，为复核提供入口。
samples.reference: Show the provenance column so review has a starting point.
samples.hypothesis: The table should display a column for the source mark of each entry to provide an entry point for verification.

samples.source: 错误恢复建议要给出可执行命令，而不是泛泛重试。
samples.reference: Offer the exact command to recover, not generic advice to retry.
samples.hypothesis: Error recovery recommendations should provide executable commands rather than generic retry suggestions.

samples.source: 界面要能只读地预览一个导入包内容。
samples.reference: Preview a pack's contents read-only before import.
samples.hypothesis: The interface should be able to preview the content of an imported package in read-only mode.

samples.source: 数字与单位之间要有明确格式，避免歧义写法。
samples.reference: Format numbers with explicit units to avoid ambiguity.
samples.hypothesis: There should be a clear format between numbers and units to avoid ambiguous writing.

samples.source: 用户自定义条目要有可见的编辑标记。
samples.reference: Show an edit marker on rows the user changed.
samples.hypothesis: User-defined entries should have visible edit markers.

samples.source: 长任务的状态转换要留下时间戳。
samples.reference: Timestamp state transitions on long-running tasks.
samples.hypothesis: State transitions of long tasks should leave a timestamp.

samples.source: 一次批量操作的错误要能定位到具体行号。
samples.reference: Pinpoint the row number for a batch failure.
samples.hypothesis: Errors in a batch operation should be able to locate to specific line numbers.

samples.source: 界面提示不要承诺无法保证的质量等级。
samples.reference: Keep UI copy from promising a quality tier it cannot guarantee.
samples.hypothesis: The interface reminds not to promise quality levels that cannot be guaranteed.

samples.source: 一个待处理状态要能区分等待外部与自身计算。
samples.reference: Separate waiting on an external service from local computation.
samples.hypothesis: A pending state should be able to distinguish between waiting for external input and internal computation.

samples.source: 界面文案要能在不改动代码的情况下校对。
samples.reference: Let UI copy be proofread without a code change.
samples.hypothesis: The interface text should be editable for proofreading without changing the code.

samples.source: 复制出的诊断内容要自带版本与环境信息。
samples.reference: Copied diagnostics must include version and environment.
samples.hypothesis: The diagnostic content copied should include version and environment information.

samples.source: 表格里显示置信度要注明口径而不是裸数字。
